## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/db/LanguageDb.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.db

import oarumi.types.OarumiJson
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.sql.Connection
import java.sql.DriverManager
import java.sql.ResultSet
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive

data class Prime(
    val id: String,
    val gloss: String,
    val category: String,
    val combinators: List<String>,
    val spokenForm: String,
    val signedForm: String,
    val tactileForm: String,
    val nsmVersion: String,
)

data class Lexeme(
    val id: Int,
    val phonForm: String,
    val click: String?,
    val tone: String?,
    val gloss: String,
    val rootClass: String,
    val frequency: Int,
)

class LanguageDb(path: Path) : AutoCloseable {
    init {
        require(path.toFile().exists()) { "language DB not found: $path" }
    }

    private val conn: Connection =
        DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:${path.toAbsolutePath()}")

    init {
        conn.createStatement().use { it.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON") }
    }

    override fun close() = conn.close()

    fun getPrime(pid: String): Prime? =
        conn.prepareStatement(
            """SELECT id, gloss, category, combinators, spoken_form, signed_form,
                      tactile_form, nsm_version
               FROM primes WHERE id = ?"""
        ).use { ps ->
            ps.setString(1, pid)
            ps.executeQuery().use { rs -> if (rs.next()) rsToPrime(rs) else null }
        }

    fun allPrimes(): List<Prime> =
        conn.prepareStatement(
            """SELECT id, gloss, category, combinators, spoken_form, signed_form,
                      tactile_form, nsm_version FROM primes ORDER BY id"""
        ).use { ps -> ps.executeQuery().use { rs -> buildList { while (rs.next()) add(rsToPrime(rs)) } } }

    fun searchLexemes(query: String, limit: Int = 20): List<Lexeme> {
        val like = "%$query%"
        return conn.prepareStatement(
            """SELECT id, phon_form, click, tone, gloss, root_class, frequency
               FROM lexemes
               WHERE phon_form LIKE ? OR gloss LIKE ?
               ORDER BY frequency DESC, id ASC
               LIMIT ?"""
        ).use { ps ->
            ps.setString(1, like); ps.setString(2, like); ps.setInt(3, limit)
            ps.executeQuery().use { rs ->
                buildList {
                    while (rs.next()) {
                        add(Lexeme(
                            id        = rs.getInt("id"),
                            phonForm  = rs.getString("phon_form"),
                            click     = rs.getString("click"),
                            tone      = rs.getString("tone"),
                            gloss     = rs.getString("gloss"),
                            rootClass = rs.getString("root_class"),
                            frequency = rs.getInt("frequency"),
                        ))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun rsToPrime(rs: ResultSet): Prime {
        val combinatorsJson = rs.getString("combinators")
        val combinators = OarumiJson.parseToJsonElement(combinatorsJson).jsonArray
            .map { it.jsonPrimitive.content }
        return Prime(
            id          = rs.getString("id"),
            gloss       = rs.getString("gloss"),
            category    = rs.getString("category"),
            combinators = combinators,
            spokenForm  = rs.getString("spoken_form"),
            signedForm  = rs.getString("signed_form"),
            tactileForm = rs.getString("tactile_form"),
            nsmVersion  = rs.getString("nsm_version"),
        )
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/pivot/PivotTranslator.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.pivot

import oarumi.config.EngineConfig
import oarumi.errors.FallbackRequiredException
import oarumi.types.PivotResult
import oarumi.types.TraceEntry

class PivotTranslator(private val config: EngineConfig) {

    fun translate(text: String, src: String, dst: String = "en"): PivotResult {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
            return PivotResult(text = "", lang = dst, source = "passthrough")
        }
        if (src == dst) {
            return PivotResult(
                text = trimmed, lang = dst, source = "passthrough",
                trace = listOf(TraceEntry("pivot", "deterministic", "src==dst")),
            )
        }

        val hit = Phrasebook.lookup(src, trimmed)
        if (hit != null) {
            return PivotResult(
                text = hit, lang = dst, source = "phrasebook",
                trace = listOf(TraceEntry("pivot", "deterministic", "phrasebook-hit")),
            )
        }

        // Batch 7 does not ship an offline neural adapter yet (Batch 10 does).
        // When offline, refuse deterministically. When online, this would try
        // ML Kit (Android) — parity tests run with OARUMI_OFFLINE=1 so this
        // branch is exercised only in non-parity Android contexts.
        if (config.offline) {
            throw FallbackRequiredException(
                "no pivot path for lang=$src, text=${trimmed.take(40)}",
                component = "pivot", trigger = "unavailable",
            )
        }

        throw FallbackRequiredException(
            "no pivot path for lang=$src, text=${trimmed.take(40)}",
            component = "pivot", trigger = "unavailable",
        )
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/nsm/Templates.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.nsm

import oarumi.types.Combinator
import oarumi.types.NsmStructure
import oarumi.types.PrimeRef

data class Template(
    val name: String,
    val pattern: Regex,
    val build: (MatchResult) -> NsmStructure,
)

private val FIRST_PERSON = setOf("i", "yo", "je", "ich")

private fun ref(id: String, role: String) = PrimeRef(id, role)
private fun clause(head: String, vararg args: String) = Combinator("clause", head, args.toList())

private fun buildWant(m: MatchResult): NsmStructure {
    val who  = (m.groups["who"]?.value ?: "someone").trim()
    val agent = if (who.lowercase() in FIRST_PERSON) "I" else "SOMEONE"
    val obj   = "SOMETHING"
    return NsmStructure(
        primes = listOf(ref(agent, "agent"), ref("WANT", "predicate"), ref(obj, "patient")),
        combinators = listOf(clause("WANT", agent, obj)),
    )
}

private fun buildSee(m: MatchResult): NsmStructure {
    val who   = (m.groups["who"]?.value ?: "someone").trim()
    val agent = if (who.lowercase() in FIRST_PERSON) "I" else "SOMEONE"
    return NsmStructure(
        primes = listOf(ref(agent, "agent"), ref("SEE", "predicate"), ref("SOMETHING", "patient")),
        combinators = listOf(clause("SEE", agent, "SOMETHING")),
    )
}

private fun buildGo(m: MatchResult): NsmStructure {
    val who   = (m.groups["who"]?.value ?: "someone").trim()
    val agent = if (who.lowercase() in FIRST_PERSON) "I" else "SOMEONE"
    return NsmStructure(
        primes = listOf(ref(agent, "agent"), ref("MOVE", "predicate"), ref("WHERE", "modifier")),
        combinators = listOf(clause("MOVE", agent, "WHERE")),
    )
}

private fun buildIsGood(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("SOMETHING", "patient"), ref("BE_SPEC", "predicate"), ref("GOOD", "argument")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "BE_SPEC", listOf("SOMETHING", "GOOD"))),
)

private fun buildIsBad(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("SOMETHING", "patient"), ref("BE_SPEC", "predicate"), ref("BAD", "argument")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "BE_SPEC", listOf("SOMETHING", "BAD"))),
)

private fun buildGreeting(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("I", "agent"), ref("SAY", "predicate"), ref("WORDS", "patient")),
    combinators = listOf(clause("SAY", "I", "WORDS")),
)

private fun buildThanks(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("I", "agent"), ref("FEEL", "predicate"), ref("GOOD", "argument")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "FEEL", listOf("I", "GOOD"))),
)

private fun buildYes(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("TRUE", "predicate")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "TRUE", emptyList())),
)

private fun buildNo(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("NOT", "operator"), ref("TRUE", "predicate")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "NOT", listOf("TRUE"))),
)

private fun buildQuestionHow(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(ref("YOU", "agent"), ref("FEEL", "predicate")),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "FEEL", listOf("YOU"))),
)

private fun buildQuestionWhere(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") m: MatchResult) = NsmStructure(
    primes = listOf(
        ref("SOMETHING", "patient"),
        ref("BE_SOMEWHERE", "predicate"),
        ref("WHERE", "modifier"),
    ),
    combinators = listOf(Combinator("predicate", "BE_SOMEWHERE", listOf("SOMETHING", "WHERE"))),
)

val TEMPLATES: List<Template> = listOf(
    Template("want",
        Regex("""^(?<who>i|he|she|they|you|someone)\s+(?:want|wants|would like)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?<what>.+?)(?:\s+(?:go|eat|sleep|leave|come))?$""",
              RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
        ::buildWant),
    Template("want_simple",
        Regex("""^(?<who>i|he|she|they|you)\s+(?:want|wants)\s+(?<what>[^.?!]+)$""",
              RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
        ::buildWant),
    Template("see",
        Regex("""^(?<who>i|he|she|they|you)\s+(?:see|sees)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?<what>[^.?!]+)$""",
              RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
        ::buildSee),
    Template("go",
        Regex("""^(?<who>i|he|she|they|you)\s+(?:want to\s+)?go$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
        ::buildGo),
    Template("is_good", Regex("""^(?:it\s+is|it's|this\s+is)\s+good$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildIsGood),
    Template("is_bad",  Regex("""^(?:it\s+is|it's|this\s+is)\s+bad$""",  RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildIsBad),
    Template("hello",   Regex("""^(?:hello|hi|good morning|good night)$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildGreeting),
    Template("thanks",  Regex("""^(?:thank you|thanks)$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildThanks),
    Template("yes",     Regex("""^yes$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildYes),
    Template("no",      Regex("""^no$""",  RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildNo),
    Template("how_are_you", Regex("""^how\s+are\s+you$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildQuestionHow),
    Template("where_is",    Regex("""^where\s+is\s+(?:the\s+)?[^.?!]+$""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE), ::buildQuestionWhere),
)
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/nsm/NSMDecomposerTierA.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.nsm

import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.errors.ValidationException
import oarumi.types.NsmStructure

class NSMDecomposerTierA(private val db: LanguageDb) {
    private val known: Set<String> = db.allPrimes().map { it.id }.toSet()

    fun decompose(pivot: String): NsmStructure {
        val text = pivot.trim()
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw ValidationException("empty pivot", listOf("empty pivot"))

        for (t in TEMPLATES) {
            val m = t.pattern.matchEntire(text) ?: continue
            val nsm = t.build(m)
            checkKnown(nsm)
            return nsm
        }
        throw ValidationException(
            "no template matched pivot '${text.take(60)}'",
            listOf("no-template:${text.take(40)}"),
        )
    }

    private fun checkKnown(nsm: NsmStructure) {
        val unknown = mutableListOf<String>()
        nsm.primes.forEach { if (it.id !in known) unknown += it.id }
        nsm.combinators.forEach { c ->
            if (c.head !in known) unknown += c.head
            c.args.forEach { if (it !in known) unknown += it }
        }
        if (unknown.isNotEmpty()) {
            val uniq = unknown.toSortedSet()
            throw ValidationException(
                "unknown prime id(s): $uniq",
                uniq.map { "unknown-prime:$it" },
            )
        }
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/nsm/NSMRealizer.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.nsm

import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.errors.ValidationException
import oarumi.types.Clitic
import oarumi.types.NsmStructure
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

class NSMRealizer(db: LanguageDb) {
    private val forms: Map<String, String> = db.allPrimes().associate { it.id to it.spokenForm }

    private val moodToClitic: Map<String, Clitic> = mapOf(
        "DECL"    to Clitic("=ha", "mood_declarative"),
        "INTERR"  to Clitic("=hu", "mood_interrogative"),
        "IMPER"   to Clitic("=hi", "mood_imperative"),
        "PROM"    to Clitic("=ho", "mood_promissive"),
        "EXPRESS" to Clitic("=he", "mood_expressive"),
        "VOC"     to Clitic("=ha", "mood_vocative"),
    )

    private val questionHeads = setOf("BE_SOMEWHERE", "FEEL")

    fun realize(nsm: NsmStructure, modality: String = "spoken"): OarumiSurface {
        if (!nsm.valid) throw ValidationException("cannot realize invalid NSM structure")
        if (nsm.primes.isEmpty()) throw ValidationException("cannot realize empty NSM structure")

        val mood = inferMood(nsm)
        val clitic = moodToClitic[mood] ?: moodToClitic["DECL"]!!
        val ordered = linearize(nsm)

        val phonemes = ordered.map { pid ->
            forms[pid] ?: throw ValidationException("no spoken form for prime $pid")
        }
        return OarumiSurface(
            phonemes = phonemes,
            clitics  = listOf(clitic),
            mood     = mood,
            modality = modality,
        )
    }

    private fun inferMood(nsm: NsmStructure): String {
        for (c in nsm.combinators) {
            if (c.head in questionHeads) {
                if ("WHERE" in c.args || c.head == "FEEL") return "INTERR"
            }
            if (c.head == "NOT") return "DECL"
        }
        return "DECL"
    }

    private fun linearize(nsm: NsmStructure): List<String> {
        val ordered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val seen = mutableSetOf<String>()
        for (c in nsm.combinators) {
            if (c.type in setOf("clause", "predicate")) {
                if (c.head !in seen) { ordered += c.head; seen += c.head }
                for (a in c.args) if (a !in seen) { ordered += a; seen += a }
            }
        }
        for (p in nsm.primes) if (p.id !in seen) { ordered += p.id; seen += p.id }
        return ordered
    }

    /** Reverse-map a surface back to an English pivot (for round-trip parity). */
    fun toCanonicalPivot(surface: OarumiSurface): String {
        val reverse = forms.entries.associate { (k, v) -> v to k }
        val ids = surface.phonemes.mapNotNull { reverse[it] }
        if ("WANT" in ids) {
            val agent = if ("I" in ids) "I" else "someone"
            return "$agent wants something"
        }
        if ("SEE" in ids) {
            val agent = if ("I" in ids) "I" else "someone"
            return "$agent see something"
        }
        if ("MOVE" in ids) {
            val agent = if ("I" in ids) "I" else "someone"
            return "$agent go"
        }
        if ("BE_SPEC" in ids && "GOOD" in ids) return "it is good"
        if ("BE_SPEC" in ids && "BAD" in ids)  return "it is bad"
        if ("SAY" in ids && "WORDS" in ids)    return "hello"
        if ("FEEL" in ids && "GOOD" in ids)    return "thank you"
        if ("FEEL" in ids && "YOU" in ids)     return "how are you"
        if ("BE_SOMEWHERE" in ids && "WHERE" in ids) return "where is the bathroom"
        if ("TRUE" in ids && "NOT" !in ids)    return "yes"
        if ("NOT" in ids && "TRUE" in ids)     return "no"
        return ""
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/nsm/NSMValidator.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.nsm

import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.types.NsmStructure

data class ValidationOutcome(val valid: Boolean, val errors: List<String>)

class NSMValidator(db: LanguageDb) {
    private val known: Set<String> = db.allPrimes().map { it.id }.toSet()

    fun validate(nsm: NsmStructure): ValidationOutcome {
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (nsm.primes.isEmpty())      errors += "no primes"
        if (nsm.combinators.isEmpty()) errors += "no combinators"

        val seen = mutableSetOf<String>()
        for (p in nsm.primes) {
            if (p.id !in known) errors += "unknown prime: ${p.id}"
            if (!seen.add(p.id)) errors += "duplicate prime: ${p.id}"
        }
        for (c in nsm.combinators) {
            if (c.type !in setOf("clause", "predicate", "modifier", "quote", "conditional"))
                errors += "bad combinator type: ${c.type}"
            if (c.head !in known) errors += "unknown head: ${c.head}"
            for (a in c.args) if (a !in known) errors += "unknown arg: $a"
        }
        return ValidationOutcome(errors.isEmpty(), errors)
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/pipeline/Pipeline.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.pipeline

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID
import oarumi.config.EngineConfig
import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.errors.FallbackRequiredException
import oarumi.errors.ValidationException
import oarumi.nsm.NSMDecomposerTierA
import oarumi.nsm.NSMRealizer
import oarumi.nsm.NSMValidator
import oarumi.pivot.PivotTranslator
import oarumi.types.FailoverEvent
import oarumi.types.InputPayload
import oarumi.types.NsmStructure
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface
import oarumi.types.PivotPayload
import oarumi.types.PivotResult
import oarumi.types.TranslationRequest
import oarumi.types.TranslationResult

class Pipeline(
    private val db: LanguageDb,
    private val config: EngineConfig,
    private val pivot: PivotTranslator = PivotTranslator(config),
    private val decomposer: NSMDecomposerTierA = NSMDecomposerTierA(db),
    private val realizer: NSMRealizer = NSMRealizer(db),
    private val validator: NSMValidator = NSMValidator(db),
) {
    fun translate(req: TranslationRequest): TranslationResult {
        val failover = mutableListOf<FailoverEvent>()

        // 1. Pivot
        val pivotResult: PivotResult = try {
            pivot.translate(req.text, req.lang, "en")
        } catch (e: FallbackRequiredException) {
            return degraded(req, emptyPivot(), failover + FailoverEvent(e.component, e.trigger, now()))
        }

        // 2. Decompose
        val nsm: NsmStructure = try {
            decomposer.decompose(pivotResult.text)
        } catch (e: ValidationException) {
            return degraded(req, pivotResult, failover + FailoverEvent("nsm_decompose", "validation", now()))
        }

        // 3. Validate (defense in depth)
        val outcome = validator.validate(nsm)
        val finalNsm = if (!outcome.valid) {
            failover += FailoverEvent("nsm_validate", "validation", now())
            nsm.copy(valid = false)
        } else nsm

        // 4. Realize
        val surface: OarumiSurface = try {
            realizer.realize(finalNsm, modality = req.modality)
        } catch (e: ValidationException) {
            return degraded(req, pivotResult, failover + FailoverEvent("nsm_realize", "validation", now()), finalNsm)
        }

        return TranslationResult(
            requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            input     = req.toPayload(),
            pivot     = PivotPayload(pivotResult.text, pivotResult.lang, pivotResult.source),
            nsm       = finalNsm,
            surface   = surface,
            modalities = emptyMap(),
            trace      = pivotResult.trace,
            failoverEvents = failover,
            degraded   = failover.isNotEmpty() || !finalNsm.valid,
        )
    }

    private fun emptyPivot() = PivotResult(text = "", lang = "en", source = "phrasebook")

    private fun degraded(
        req: TranslationRequest,
        pivot: PivotResult,
        events: List<FailoverEvent>,
        nsm: NsmStructure = NsmStructure.EMPTY,
    ): TranslationResult = TranslationResult(
        requestId = "",
        input     = req.toPayload(),
        pivot     = PivotPayload(pivot.text, pivot.lang, pivot.source),
        nsm       = nsm,
        surface   = OarumiSurface.empty(req.modality),
        modalities = emptyMap(),
        trace      = pivot.trace,
        failoverEvents = events,
        degraded   = true,
    )

    private fun now(): String = Instant.now().toString()
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/JsonCanonicalizer.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi

import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray

/**
 * Strip the fields that cannot be equal across platforms or across runs.
 * Mirrors tools/parity_runner.py::_canonical.
 */
object JsonCanonicalizer {
    fun canonical(element: JsonElement?): JsonElement? {
        if (element == null) return null
        val obj = element.jsonObject
        val out = obj.toMutableMap()

        out.remove("request_id")

        val events = out["failover_events"]?.jsonArray
        if (events != null) {
            val cleaned = events.map { ev ->
                val evObj = ev.jsonObject.toMutableMap()
                evObj.remove("t")
                JsonObject(evObj)
            }
            out["failover_events"] = kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray(cleaned)
        }

        val mods = out["modalities"]?.jsonObject
        if (mods != null) {
            val cleaned = mods.mapValues { (_, v) ->
                val vObj = v.jsonObject.toMutableMap()
                vObj.remove("audio_path")
                vObj.remove("duration_ms")
                JsonObject(vObj)
            }
            out["modalities"] = JsonObject(cleaned)
        }

        return JsonObject(out)
    }

    fun isEphemeral(key: String): Boolean = key in setOf(
        "request_id", "audio_path", "duration_ms",
    )

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun unusedPrimitive(p: JsonPrimitive) = p  // keep import
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/ParityTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.extension
import kotlin.io.path.readText
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue
import oarumi.config.EngineConfig
import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.pipeline.Pipeline
import oarumi.types.OarumiJson
import oarumi.types.TranslationRequest
import oarumi.types.TranslationResult

class ParityTest {

    private val corpusDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("oarumi.parity.data") ?: "../tests/parity/data")
            .resolve("parity-basic")

    private val dbPath: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("oarumi.db") ?: "../language/oarumi.db")

    @Test
    fun `kotlin engine matches python gold`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(corpusDir), "corpus dir missing: $corpusDir")
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(dbPath),   "language DB missing: $dbPath (run ./scripts/bootstrap.sh)")

        val cases = Files.list(corpusDir)
            .filter { it.extension == "json" }
            .sorted()
            .toList()
        assumeTrue(cases.isNotEmpty(), "corpus empty — Batch 13 populates it")

        val config = EngineConfig(
            home = dbPath.parent.parent.toAbsolutePath(),
            strictParity = true, devModels = true, offline = true, logLevel = "INFO",
        )

        LanguageDb(dbPath).use { db ->
            val pipeline = Pipeline(db = db, config = config)
            var compared = 0
            var passed = 0
            val failures = mutableListOf<String>()

            for (casePath in cases) {
                val caseObj = Json.parseToJsonElement(casePath.readText()).jsonObject
                val requestObj = caseObj["request"]?.jsonObject ?: continue
                val req = TranslationRequest(
                    text = requestObj["text"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
                    lang = requestObj["lang"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
                    modality = requestObj["modality"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: "spoken",
                    targetModality = requestObj["target_modality"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content,
                )

                val got: TranslationResult = pipeline.translate(req)
                val gotJson = OarumiJson.encodeToJsonElement(
                    TranslationResult.serializer(), got,
                )

                val expected = caseObj["expected"]
                if (expected == null) continue

                compared += 1
                val match = JsonCanonicalizer.canonical(gotJson) ==
                            JsonCanonicalizer.canonical(expected)
                if (match) passed += 1
                else failures += "case=${casePath.fileName}: got=${gotJson} expected=$expected"
            }

            if (compared == 0) return  // nothing to compare; passes with note

            assertTrue(failures.isEmpty(),
                "parity failures ($passed/$compared passed):\n" + failures.joinToString("\n"))
            assertTrue(passed == compared)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `deterministic path produces identical request for identical input`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(dbPath), "language DB missing")
        val config = EngineConfig(
            home = dbPath.parent.parent.toAbsolutePath(),
            strictParity = true, devModels = true, offline = true, logLevel = "INFO",
        )
        LanguageDb(dbPath).use { db ->
            val pipeline = Pipeline(db = db, config = config)
            val req = TranslationRequest(text = "hola", lang = "es", modality = "spoken")
            val a = pipeline.translate(req)
            val b = pipeline.translate(req)
            // request_id and failover timestamps differ; everything else must match.
            assertTrue(
                JsonCanonicalizer.canonical(
                    OarumiJson.encodeToJsonElement(TranslationResult.serializer(), a)
                ) ==
                JsonCanonicalizer.canonical(
                    OarumiJson.encodeToJsonElement(TranslationResult.serializer(), b)
                )
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject

/**
 * Byte-identical to the Python AuditLog:
 *   - one JSON object per line
 *   - no whitespace
 *   - key order: id, t, component, event, payload
 *   - rotation at maxBytes (10 MB default)
 */
@Serializable
data class AuditEvent(
    val id: String,
    val t: String,
    val component: String,
    val event: String,
    val payload: JsonObject = JsonObject(emptyMap()),
) {
    companion object {
        private val isoFormatter = DateTimeFormatter
            .ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")
            .withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC)

        fun make(component: String, event: String, payload: Map<String, JsonElement>): AuditEvent =
            AuditEvent(
                id        = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                t         = isoFormatter.format(Instant.now()),
                component = component,
                event     = event,
                payload   = JsonObject(payload),
            )

        /** Variant that accepts primitives so callers do not build JsonElements by hand. */
        fun make(component: String, event: String, vararg pairs: Pair<String, Any?>): AuditEvent {
            val map = buildJsonObject {
                for ((k, v) in pairs) {
                    when (v) {
                        null       -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(""))
                        is String  -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        is Boolean -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        is Int     -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        is Long    -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        is Double  -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        is Float   -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v))
                        else       -> put(k, JsonPrimitive(v.toString()))
                    }
                }
            }
            return AuditEvent(
                id        = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                t         = isoFormatter.format(Instant.now()),
                component = component,
                event     = event,
                payload   = map,
            )
        }
    }
}

private val AUDIT_JSON = Json {
    encodeDefaults = true
    explicitNulls = false
    prettyPrint = false
}

class AuditLog(
    val path: Path,
    private val maxBytes: Long = 10L * 1024 * 1024,
) {
    private val lock = Any()

    init {
        path.parent?.let { Files.createDirectories(it) }
    }

    fun log(event: AuditEvent) {
        val line = AUDIT_JSON.encodeToString(AuditEvent.serializer(), event)
        synchronized(lock) {
            rotateIfNeeded(line.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size + 1)
            Files.write(
                path,
                (line + "\n").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8),
                StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.APPEND,
            )
        }
    }

    fun logSimple(component: String, event: String, vararg pairs: Pair<String, Any?>) {
        log(AuditEvent.make(component, event, *pairs))
    }

    fun replay(): List<AuditEvent> {
        val out = mutableListOf<AuditEvent>()
        val dir = path.parent ?: return out
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) return out
        val rotated = Files.list(dir)
            .filter { it.fileName.toString().startsWith("${path.fileName}.") }
            .sorted()
            .toList()
        for (f in rotated) out += readFile(f)
        out += readFile(path)
        return out
    }

    private fun readFile(p: Path): List<AuditEvent> {
        if (!Files.exists(p)) return emptyList()
        return Files.readAllLines(p, Charsets.UTF_8)
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            .mapNotNull { line ->
                runCatching {
                    AUDIT_JSON.decodeFromString(AuditEvent.serializer(), line)
                }.getOrNull()
            }
    }

    private fun rotateIfNeeded(incoming: Long) {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return
        val size = runCatching { Files.size(path) }.getOrDefault(0L)
        if (size + incoming <= maxBytes) return
        val stamp = DateTimeFormatter
            .ofPattern("yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss")
            .withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC)
            .format(Instant.now())
        val target = path.resolveSibling("${path.fileName}.$stamp")
        Files.move(path, target)
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/IntentRouter.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.pivot.Phrasebook
import oarumi.types.Route
import oarumi.types.TranslationRequest

interface CapabilitySource {
    fun hasLanguage(lang: String): Boolean
    fun hasModality(modality: String): Boolean
    fun isOffline(): Boolean
    fun hasNeuralPivot(src: String, dst: String): Boolean
    fun hasPhrasebook(src: String): Boolean
}

data class StaticCapabilitySource(
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") val db: LanguageDb? = null,
    val offline: Boolean = false,
    val extraLangs: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val neuralLangs: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val modalities: Set<String> = setOf("spoken", "signed", "tactile", "text"),
) : CapabilitySource {
    private val phrasebookLangs: Set<String> = Phrasebook.supportedLanguages().toSet()

    override fun hasLanguage(lang: String) = lang in extraLangs || lang in phrasebookLangs
    override fun hasModality(modality: String) = modality in modalities
    override fun isOffline() = offline
    override fun hasNeuralPivot(src: String, dst: String) =
        !offline && src in neuralLangs && dst == "en"
    override fun hasPhrasebook(src: String) = src in phrasebookLangs
}

class IntentRouter(val source: CapabilitySource) {
    fun route(req: TranslationRequest): Route {
        val text = req.text.trim()
        if (text.isEmpty()) return Route("refuse", "empty_input")

        if (!source.hasLanguage(req.lang))
            return Route("refuse", "unsupported_language", listOf(req.lang))

        if (!source.hasModality(req.modality))
            return Route("refuse", "unsupported_modality", listOf(req.modality))

        // Phrasebook hit: deterministic, zero-latency.
        if (source.hasPhrasebook(req.lang) && Phrasebook.lookup(req.lang, text) != null) {
            return Route("direct_deterministic", "phrasebook_hit", listOf("phrasebook"))
        }

        // Otherwise, a neural path is viable if the adapter is installed.
        if (source.hasNeuralPivot(req.lang, "en")) {
            return Route("neural_candidate", "neural_pivot_available", listOf("pivot_adapter"))
        }

        return Route("refuse", "no_pivot_path", listOf(req.lang))
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/Watchdog.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

data class WatchdogHandle(
    val component: String,
    val deadlineAtNanos: Long,
    val done: AtomicBoolean = AtomicBoolean(false),
    val fired: AtomicBoolean = AtomicBoolean(false),
) {
    fun isDone()  = done.get()
    fun isFired() = fired.get()
}

/**
 * Deadline tracker on a single daemon scheduler thread.
 *
 * Uses ScheduledExecutorService so the same code runs on the JVM (tests) and
 * on Android (which also has java.util.concurrent since API 1).
 *
 * The watchdog never blocks the caller. `completed()` sets an AtomicBoolean;
 * the scheduler notices on the next tick.
 */
class Watchdog(
    private val onTimeout: (WatchdogHandle) -> Unit,
    private val tickMs: Long = 50L,
) {
    init {
        require(tickMs > 0) { "tickMs must be positive" }
    }

    private val scheduler: ScheduledExecutorService =
        Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor { r ->
            Thread(r, "oarumi-watchdog").apply { isDaemon = true }
        }

    private val handles = ConcurrentHashMap<Long, WatchdogHandle>()
    private val seq = AtomicLong(0)
    @Volatile private var started = false
    @Volatile private var stopped = false

    @Synchronized
    fun start() {
        if (started) return
        started = true
        scheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate({ runTick() }, 0, tickMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
    }

    fun stop() {
        stopped = true
        scheduler.shutdownNow()
    }

    fun arm(component: String, deadlineS: Double): WatchdogHandle {
        require(deadlineS > 0) { "deadlineS must be positive" }
        val now = System.nanoTime()
        val h = WatchdogHandle(
            component = component,
            deadlineAtNanos = now + (deadlineS * 1_000_000_000L).toLong(),
        )
        handles[seq.incrementAndGet()] = h
        return h
    }

    fun completed(h: WatchdogHandle) {
        h.done.set(true)
    }

    private fun runTick() {
        if (stopped) return
        val now = System.nanoTime()
        val fired = mutableListOf<WatchdogHandle>()
        val it = handles.entries.iterator()
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            val entry = it.next()
            val h = entry.value
            if (h.done.get()) { it.remove(); continue }
            if (now >= h.deadlineAtNanos && !h.fired.get()) {
                h.fired.set(true)
                fired += h
                it.remove()
            }
        }
        for (h in fired) {
            runCatching { onTimeout(h) }  // callbacks must not kill the scheduler
        }
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/RecoveryFsm.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

enum class FsmState { HEALTHY, DEGRADED, FAILED, RECOVERING }

data class Transition(
    val from: FsmState,
    val to: FsmState,
    val reason: String,
    val t: Long,        // System.nanoTime()
)

class RecoveryFsm(
    val component: String,
    var onTransition: ((Transition) -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    var state: FsmState = FsmState.HEALTHY
        private set
    var attempt: Int = 0
        private set
    var lastRetryAt: Long = 0L
        private set
    val history: MutableList<Transition> = mutableListOf()

    private fun move(to: FsmState, reason: String) {
        if (to == FsmState.HEALTHY && state == FsmState.RECOVERING && reason != "canary_pass") {
            throw IllegalStateException(
                "cannot enter HEALTHY from RECOVERING without reason='canary_pass'"
            )
        }
        val tr = Transition(from = state, to = to, reason = reason, t = System.nanoTime())
        state = to
        history += tr
        onTransition?.invoke(tr)
    }

    fun onTrigger(reason: String = "trigger") {
        when (state) {
            FsmState.HEALTHY  -> move(FsmState.DEGRADED, reason)
            FsmState.DEGRADED -> move(FsmState.FAILED,   reason)
            else              -> { /* no-op; Python is likewise silent */ }
        }
    }

    fun onCanaryPass() {
        if (state !in setOf(FsmState.DEGRADED, FsmState.FAILED, FsmState.RECOVERING)) return
        attempt = 0
        move(FsmState.RECOVERING, "canary_start")
        move(FsmState.HEALTHY,    "canary_pass")
    }

    fun onCanaryFail() {
        if (state != FsmState.RECOVERING) {
            state = FsmState.FAILED  // Python forces this then records the transition
        }
        attempt += 1
        lastRetryAt = System.nanoTime()
        move(FsmState.FAILED, "canary_fail")
    }

    fun onRollback() {
        attempt = 0
        move(FsmState.FAILED, "rollback")
    }

    fun backoffS(base: Double = 1.0, cap: Double = 60.0): Double =
        minOf(cap, base * Math.pow(2.0, maxOf(0, attempt - 1).toDouble()))

    fun readyForRetry(): Boolean {
        if (state != FsmState.FAILED) return false
        val elapsedS = (System.nanoTime() - lastRetryAt) / 1_000_000_000.0
        return elapsedS >= backoffS()
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/SymbolicShield.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.ValidationOutcome

data class ParityContract(
    val validityRequired: Boolean = true,
    val latencyCeilingMs: Long = 2000L,
    val requireDoubleRunEqual: Boolean = false,
)

data class ShieldResult<O>(
    val decision: String,        // "use_neural" | "use_fallback" | "refuse"
    val output: O?,
    val reason: String,
    val latencyMs: Double,
)

class SymbolicShield(
    private val audit: AuditLog,
    private val watchdog: Watchdog? = null,
) {
    fun <I, O> wrap(
        component: String,
        neural: (I) -> O,
        validator: (O) -> ValidationOutcome,
        fallback: (I) -> O,
        contract: ParityContract,
        normalizer: ((O) -> String)? = null,
    ): (I) -> ShieldResult<O> {
        return { input ->
            val t0 = System.nanoTime()

            var neuralOutput: O? = null
            var neuralReason = "ok"

            try {
                neuralOutput = if (watchdog != null) {
                    val handle = watchdog.arm(component, contract.latencyCeilingMs / 1000.0)
                    try { neural(input) } finally { watchdog.completed(handle) }
                } else {
                    neural(input)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                neuralReason = "exception:${e::class.simpleName ?: "Unknown"}"
            }

            val latencyMs = (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000.0

            if (neuralOutput != null && neuralReason == "ok") {
                val outcome = validator(neuralOutput)
                if (contract.validityRequired && !outcome.valid) {
                    neuralReason = "invalid"
                } else if (latencyMs > contract.latencyCeilingMs) {
                    neuralReason = "latency"
                } else if (contract.requireDoubleRunEqual && normalizer != null) {
                    val second = neural(input)
                    if (normalizer(neuralOutput) != normalizer(second)) {
                        neuralReason = "inconsistent"
                    }
                }
            }

            if (neuralOutput != null && neuralReason == "ok") {
                audit.logSimple(
                    component, "shield_decision",
                    "decision"   to "use_neural",
                    "latency_ms" to latencyMs,
                )
                return@wrap ShieldResult(
                    decision = "use_neural",
                    output   = neuralOutput,
                    reason   = "ok",
                    latencyMs = latencyMs,
                )
            }

            // Fallback.
            val fb: O? = try {
                fallback(input)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                audit.logSimple(
                    component, "shield_decision",
                    "decision"          to "refuse",
                    "neural_reason"     to neuralReason,
                    "fallback_error"    to (e::class.simpleName ?: "Unknown"),
                )
                return@wrap ShieldResult(
                    decision = "refuse",
                    output   = null,
                    reason   = "fallback_failed:${e::class.simpleName ?: "Unknown"}",
                    latencyMs = latencyMs,
                )
            }

            audit.logSimple(
                component, "shield_decision",
                "decision"       to "use_fallback",
                "neural_reason"  to neuralReason,
                "latency_ms"     to latencyMs,
            )
            ShieldResult(
                decision = "use_fallback",
                output   = fb,
                reason   = neuralReason,
                latencyMs = latencyMs,
            )
        }
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun jp(s: String) = JsonPrimitive(s)  // keep import usable
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/Canary.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.extension
import kotlin.io.path.nameWithoutExtension
import kotlin.io.path.readText
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

data class CanaryCase(
    val name: String,
    val input: JsonElement,
    val expected: JsonElement,
)

data class CanaryResult(
    val passed: Boolean,
    val total: Int,
    val failures: List<String>,
)

class Canary(private val root: Path) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }

    fun load(component: String): List<CanaryCase> {
        val base = root.resolve(component)
        if (!Files.exists(base)) return emptyList()
        return Files.list(base)
            .filter { it.extension == "json" }
            .sorted()
            .map { path ->
                val obj = json.parseToJsonElement(path.readText()).jsonObject
                CanaryCase(
                    name     = path.nameWithoutExtension,
                    input    = obj["input"]    ?: Json.parseToJsonElement("{}"),
                    expected = obj["expected"] ?: Json.parseToJsonElement("{}"),
                )
            }
            .toList()
    }

    fun run(
        component: String,
        call: (JsonElement) -> JsonElement,
    ): CanaryResult {
        val cases = load(component)
        if (cases.isEmpty()) {
            return CanaryResult(passed = false, total = 0, failures = listOf("no_cases"))
        }
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (case in cases) {
            val got = try {
                call(case.input)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                failures += "${case.name}:raised:${e::class.simpleName ?: "Unknown"}"
                continue
            }
            if (got != case.expected) {
                failures += "${case.name}:mismatch"
            }
        }
        return CanaryResult(
            passed   = failures.isEmpty(),
            total    = cases.size,
            failures = failures,
        )
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/Reliability.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

/**
 * Convenience aggregator so callers only need one import.
 *
 * Batch 8 does not wire this into Pipeline yet; Batch 10 (Android data layer)
 * and Batch 14 (parity web) will consume it.
 */
data class ReliabilityStack(
    val audit: AuditLog,
    val watchdog: Watchdog,
    val shield: SymbolicShield,
    val router: IntentRouter,
    val canary: Canary,
) {
    companion object {
        fun create(
            auditPath: java.nio.file.Path,
            canaryRoot: java.nio.file.Path,
            capabilities: CapabilitySource,
            onTimeout: ((WatchdogHandle) -> Unit)? = null,
        ): ReliabilityStack {
            val audit = AuditLog(auditPath)
            val wd = Watchdog(onTimeout = onTimeout ?: { h ->
                audit.logSimple(
                    "watchdog", "timeout",
                    "component" to h.component,
                )
            })
            wd.start()
            val shield = SymbolicShield(audit = audit, watchdog = wd)
            val router = IntentRouter(capabilities)
            val canary = Canary(canaryRoot)
            return ReliabilityStack(audit, wd, shield, router, canary)
        }
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/AuditLogTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.createTempDirectory
import kotlin.io.path.readText
import kotlin.io.path.writeText
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class AuditLogTest {

    private fun temp(): Path = createTempDirectory("oarumi-audit-")

    @Test
    fun `append and replay round trip`() {
        val dir = temp()
        val log = AuditLog(dir.resolve("audit.jsonl"))
        log.logSimple("pivot", "hello", "value" to 1)
        log.logSimple("pivot", "world", "value" to 2)
        val events = log.replay()
        assertEquals(listOf("hello", "world"), events.map { it.event })
    }

    @Test
    fun `rotation keeps at most one active file under size`() {
        val dir = temp()
        val log = AuditLog(dir.resolve("audit.jsonl"), maxBytes = 200)
        repeat(20) { log.logSimple("x", "e", "i" to it) }
        val rotated = Files.list(dir).filter { it.fileName.toString().contains("audit.jsonl.") }.count()
        assertTrue(rotated >= 1, "expected at least one rotated file")
    }

    @Test
    fun `line format matches python`() {
        val dir = temp()
        val path = dir.resolve("audit.jsonl")
        val log = AuditLog(path)
        log.logSimple("pivot", "test_event", "decision" to "use_neural", "latency_ms" to 1.5)
        val firstLine = path.readText().trim()
        // Key order: id, t, component, event, payload
        assertTrue(firstLine.startsWith("{\"id\":\""), "line starts: $firstLine")
        assertTrue(firstLine.contains("\"component\":\"pivot\""))
        assertTrue(firstLine.contains("\"event\":\"test_event\""))
        assertTrue(firstLine.contains("\"decision\":\"use_neural\""))
        assertTrue(firstLine.contains("\"latency_ms\":1.5"))
        // No whitespace outside strings.
        val stripped = firstLine.replace(Regex("\"[^\"]*\""), "\"\"")
        assertTrue(!stripped.contains(" "), "unexpected whitespace in: $firstLine")
    }

    @Test
    fun `can read python-produced log`() {
        // A line written by the Python AuditLog (see fixtures).
        val line = """{"id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","t":"2026-01-01T00:00:00","component":"pivot","event":"test","payload":{"decision":"use_neural","latency_ms":1.5}}"""
        val dir = temp()
        val path = dir.resolve("audit.jsonl")
        path.writeText(line + "\n")
        val log = AuditLog(path)
        val events = log.replay()
        assertEquals(1, events.size)
        assertEquals("pivot", events[0].component)
        assertEquals("test", events[0].event)
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/WatchdogTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class WatchdogTest {

    @Test
    fun `completion prevents timeout`() {
        val fired = AtomicInteger(0)
        val wd = Watchdog(onTimeout = { fired.incrementAndGet() }, tickMs = 5)
        wd.start()
        try {
            val h = wd.arm("x", deadlineS = 0.5)
            wd.completed(h)
            Thread.sleep(200)
            assertEquals(0, fired.get())
        } finally {
            wd.stop()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `timeout fires when deadline passes`() {
        val fired = AtomicInteger(0)
        val wd = Watchdog(onTimeout = { fired.incrementAndGet() }, tickMs = 5)
        wd.start()
        try {
            val h = wd.arm("x", deadlineS = 0.05)
            val end = System.currentTimeMillis() + 500
            while (fired.get() == 0 && System.currentTimeMillis() < end) Thread.sleep(10)
            assertEquals(1, fired.get())
            assertTrue(h.isFired())
        } finally {
            wd.stop()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `callback exception does not kill the watchdog`() {
        val wd = Watchdog(
            onTimeout = { throw RuntimeException("handler failed") },
            tickMs = 5,
        )
        wd.start()
        try {
            wd.arm("a", deadlineS = 0.02)
            wd.arm("b", deadlineS = 0.02)
            Thread.sleep(150)
            // If the scheduler died, arm+timeout would not fire again.
            wd.arm("c", deadlineS = 0.02)
            Thread.sleep(150)
        } finally {
            wd.stop()
        }
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/RecoveryFsmTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class RecoveryFsmTest {

    @Test
    fun `healthy to degraded to failed`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        fsm.onTrigger("validation")
        assertEquals(FsmState.DEGRADED, fsm.state)
        fsm.onTrigger("validation")
        assertEquals(FsmState.FAILED, fsm.state)
    }

    @Test
    fun `cannot enter healthy from recovering without canary_pass`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        fsm.onTrigger("x")
        // Force into RECOVERING via the private-transition path.
        val method = fsm.javaClass.getDeclaredMethod("move", FsmState::class.java, String::class.java)
        method.isAccessible = true
        method.invoke(fsm, FsmState.RECOVERING, "manual")
        assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> {
            method.invoke(fsm, FsmState.HEALTHY, "manual")
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `canary pass from degraded recovers`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        fsm.onTrigger("x")
        fsm.onCanaryPass()
        assertEquals(FsmState.HEALTHY, fsm.state)
        assertEquals(0, fsm.attempt)
    }

    @Test
    fun `canary fail schedules retry`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        fsm.onTrigger("x")
        // Enter RECOVERING without completing the pair.
        fsm.javaClass.getDeclaredMethod("move", FsmState::class.java, String::class.java)
            .also { it.isAccessible = true }
            .invoke(fsm, FsmState.RECOVERING, "canary_start")
        fsm.onCanaryFail()
        assertEquals(FsmState.FAILED, fsm.state)
        assertEquals(1, fsm.attempt)
        assertFalse(fsm.readyForRetry())
    }

    @Test
    fun `backoff grows and caps`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        assertEquals(1.0, fsm.backoffS(), 1e-9)
        fsm.onTrigger("a"); fsm.onTrigger("a")
        fsm.javaClass.getDeclaredMethod("move", FsmState::class.java, String::class.java)
            .also { it.isAccessible = true }
            .invoke(fsm, FsmState.RECOVERING, "canary_start")
        fsm.onCanaryFail() // attempt=1
        assertEquals(1.0, fsm.backoffS(), 1e-9)
        fsm.onCanaryFail() // attempt=2
        assertEquals(2.0, fsm.backoffS(), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun `history records every transition`() {
        val fsm = RecoveryFsm("pivot")
        fsm.onTrigger("a")
        fsm.onTrigger("b")
        fsm.onCanaryPass()
        val reasons = fsm.history.map { it.reason }
        assertTrue("a" in reasons)
        assertTrue("b" in reasons)
        assertTrue("canary_pass" in reasons)
        assertEquals(FsmState.HEALTHY, fsm.history.first().from)
        assertEquals(FsmState.HEALTHY, fsm.history.last().to)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.types.TranslationRequest

class IntentRouterTest {

    private val dbPath: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("oarumi.db") ?: "../language/oarumi.db")

    private fun router(offline: Boolean = true, neural: Set<String> = emptySet(),
                       modalities: Set<String> = setOf("spoken","signed","tactile","text")): IntentRouter {
        val db = LanguageDb(dbPath)
        return IntentRouter(StaticCapabilitySource(
            db = db, offline = offline, neuralLangs = neural, modalities = modalities,
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun `empty input refuses`() {
        val r = router().route(TranslationRequest(text = "   ", lang = "es"))
        assertEquals("refuse", r.kind)
        assertEquals("empty_input", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `unsupported language refuses`() {
        val r = router().route(TranslationRequest(text = "hola", lang = "xx"))
        assertEquals("refuse", r.kind)
        assertEquals("unsupported_language", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `unsupported modality refuses`() {
        val r = router(modalities = setOf("text"))
            .route(TranslationRequest(text = "hola", lang = "es", modality = "spoken"))
        assertEquals("refuse", r.kind)
        assertEquals("unsupported_modality", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `phrasebook hit is direct`() {
        val r = router().route(TranslationRequest(text = "hola", lang = "es"))
        assertEquals("direct_deterministic", r.kind)
        assertEquals("phrasebook_hit", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `neural available for phrasebook miss`() {
        val r = router(offline = false, neural = setOf("es"))
            .route(TranslationRequest(text = "unknown phrase", lang = "es"))
        assertEquals("neural_candidate", r.kind)
        assertEquals("neural_pivot_available", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `no path refuses`() {
        val r = router()
            .route(TranslationRequest(text = "not in book", lang = "es"))
        assertEquals("refuse", r.kind)
        assertEquals("no_pivot_path", r.reason)
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/ShieldTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.createTempDirectory
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import oarumi.types.ValidationOutcome

class ShieldTest {

    private val valid = ValidationOutcome(true, emptyList())
    private val invalid = ValidationOutcome(false, listOf("bad"))

    private fun shield(): SymbolicShield {
        val dir = createTempDirectory("oarumi-shield-")
        return SymbolicShield(AuditLog(dir.resolve("audit.jsonl")))
    }

    @Test
    fun `use neural when valid`() {
        val call = shield().wrap<Int, String>(
            component = "x",
            neural = { "ok" },
            validator = { valid },
            fallback = { "fb" },
            contract = ParityContract(validityRequired = true, latencyCeilingMs = 1000),
        )
        val r = call(1)
        assertEquals("use_neural", r.decision)
        assertEquals("ok", r.output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `use fallback when invalid`() {
        val call = shield().wrap<Int, String>(
            component = "x",
            neural = { "bad" },
            validator = { invalid },
            fallback = { "fb" },
            contract = ParityContract(validityRequired = true, latencyCeilingMs = 1000),
        )
        val r = call(1)
        assertEquals("use_fallback", r.decision)
        assertEquals("fb", r.output)
        assertEquals("invalid", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `use fallback when neural raises`() {
        val call = shield().wrap<Int, String>(
            component = "x",
            neural = { throw RuntimeException("boom") },
            validator = { valid },
            fallback = { "fb" },
            contract = ParityContract(),
        )
        val r = call(1)
        assertEquals("use_fallback", r.decision)
        assertEquals("exception:RuntimeException", r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `refuse when both fail`() {
        val call = shield().wrap<Int, String>(
            component = "x",
            neural = { "bad" },
            validator = { invalid },
            fallback = { throw RuntimeException("fb") },
            contract = ParityContract(),
        )
        val r = call(1)
        assertEquals("refuse", r.decision)
        assertNull(r.output)
        assertNotNull(r.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun `decision is audited`() {
        val dir = createTempDirectory("oarumi-shield-")
        val path = dir.resolve("audit.jsonl")
        val log = AuditLog(path)
        val call = SymbolicShield(log).wrap<Int, String>(
            component = "pivot",
            neural = { "bad" },
            validator = { invalid },
            fallback = { "fb" },
            contract = ParityContract(),
        )
        call(1)
        val raw = path.toFile().readText()
        assertEquals(true, raw.contains("shield_decision"))
        assertEquals(true, raw.contains("use_fallback"))
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/CanaryTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.createTempDirectory
import kotlin.io.path.writeText
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement

class CanaryTest {

    private val json = Json
    private fun writeCase(dir: Path, name: String, input: String, expected: String) {
        Files.createDirectories(dir)
        dir.resolve("$name.json").writeText("""{"input": $input, "expected": $expected}""")
    }

    @Test
    fun `no cases fails`() {
        val canary = Canary(createTempDirectory("canary-"))
        val r = canary.run("pivot") { it }
        assertFalse(r.passed)
        assertTrue("no_cases" in r.failures)
    }

    @Test
    fun `all pass`() {
        val dir = createTempDirectory("canary-")
        writeCase(dir.resolve("pivot"), "a", """{"x": 1}""", """{"y": 2}""")
        writeCase(dir.resolve("pivot"), "b", """{"x": 3}""", """{"y": 6}""")
        val canary = Canary(dir)
        val r = canary.run("pivot") { input ->
            // Double x's value.
            val x = input.toString().substringAfter(":").substringBefore("}").trim().toInt()
            json.parseToJsonElement("""{"y": ${x * 2}}""")
        }
        assertTrue(r.passed)
        assertEquals(2, r.total)
    }

    @Test
    fun `callback raises fails`() {
        val dir = createTempDirectory("canary-")
        writeCase(dir.resolve("pivot"), "a", """{"x": 1}""", """{"y": 2}""")
        val canary = Canary(dir)
        val r = canary.run("pivot") { throw RuntimeException("boom") }
        assertFalse(r.passed)
        assertTrue(r.failures.any { it.contains("raised:RuntimeException") })
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/reliability/CrossLanguageShieldTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.reliability

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.createTempDirectory
import kotlin.io.path.readText
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.ValidationOutcome

/**
 * Loads tests/parity/data/reliability/scenarios.json (also consumed by the
 * Python shield test) and asserts that the Kotlin shield makes the same
 * decision the Python shield is expected to make.
 */
class CrossLanguageShieldTest {

    private val fixtureDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("oarumi.parity.data") ?: "../tests/parity/data")
            .resolve("reliability")

    @Test
    fun `kotlin shield matches python scenarios`() {
        val file = fixtureDir.resolve("scenarios.json")
        if (!Files.exists(file)) return  // tolerate fresh clone before Batch 13

        val scenarios = Json.parseToJsonElement(file.readText()).jsonObject["scenarios"]!!
            .jsonArray

        for (s in scenarios) {
            val obj       = s.jsonObject
            val name      = obj["name"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content
            val neuralSpec   = obj["neural"]!!.jsonObject
            val fallbackSpec = obj["fallback"]!!.jsonObject
            val contractSpec = obj["contract"]!!.jsonObject
            val expectedDecision = obj["expected_decision"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content

            val neuralReturns  = neuralSpec["returns"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content
            val neuralRaises   = neuralSpec["raises"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content
            val fallbackReturns = fallbackSpec["returns"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content
            val fallbackRaises  = fallbackSpec["raises"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content

            val validityRequired =
                contractSpec["validity_required"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content.toBoolean()
            val latencyCeiling =
                contractSpec["latency_ceiling_ms"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content.toLong()

            val auditPath = createTempDirectory("xl-${name}-").resolve("audit.jsonl")
            val shield = SymbolicShield(AuditLog(auditPath))

            val call = shield.wrap<Int, String>(
                component = name,
                neural = {
                    if (neuralRaises != null) throw RuntimeException("simulated")
                    "x"
                },
                validator = {
                    if (neuralReturns == "valid") ValidationOutcome(true)
                    else ValidationOutcome(false, listOf("bad"))
                },
                fallback = {
                    if (fallbackRaises != null) throw RuntimeException("simulated")
                    "fb"
                },
                contract = ParityContract(
                    validityRequired = validityRequired,
                    latencyCeilingMs = latencyCeiling,
                ),
            )
            val r = call(1)
            assertEquals(
                expectedDecision, r.decision,
                "scenario '$name' produced '${r.decision}' (reason='${r.reason}')",
            )
        }
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/RenderOutput.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive

/**
 * Envelope that mirrors the Python RenderOutput.to_json() shape:
 *
 *   {
 *     "modality": "...",
 *     ...payload...,
 *     "valid": true,
 *     "errors": [...]   // only when non-empty
 *   }
 */
data class RenderOutput(
    val modality: String,
    val payload: Map<String, JsonElement> = emptyMap(),
    val valid: Boolean = true,
    val errors: List<String> = emptyList(),
) {
    fun toJsonObject(): JsonObject {
        val map = LinkedHashMap<String, JsonElement>()
        map["modality"] = JsonPrimitive(modality)
        for ((k, v) in payload) map[k] = v
        map["valid"] = JsonPrimitive(valid)
        if (errors.isNotEmpty()) {
            map["errors"] = JsonArray(errors.map { JsonPrimitive(it) })
        }
        return JsonObject(map)
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/AudioSource.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path

/**
 * Platform-neutral access to the audio asset bundle.
 *
 * The JVM implementation reads from the file system; the Android
 * implementation (Batch 10) reads via AssetManager. The AudioAssetLibrary
 * itself only needs to read text and bytes.
 */
interface AudioSource {
    fun exists(relPath: String): Boolean
    fun readText(relPath: String): String
    fun readBytes(relPath: String): ByteArray
}

class FileSystemAudioSource(private val baseDir: Path) : AudioSource {
    override fun exists(relPath: String): Boolean =
        Files.exists(baseDir.resolve(relPath))

    override fun readText(relPath: String): String =
        Files.readString(baseDir.resolve(relPath))

    override fun readBytes(relPath: String): ByteArray =
        Files.readAllBytes(baseDir.resolve(relPath))
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/AudioAssetLibrary.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import oarumi.errors.IntegrityException

data class AudioAsset(
    val id: String,
    val relPath: String,
    val sha256: String,
    val sampleRate: Int,
)

/**
 * Parses assets/audio/manifest.json and verifies each file's hash.
 * Matches Python's AudioAssetLibrary semantics exactly.
 */
class AudioAssetLibrary(
    private val source: AudioSource,
    requireVerified: Boolean = false,
) {
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }

    private val assets: Map<String, AudioAsset>
    val sampleRate: Int

    init {
        if (!source.exists("manifest.json")) {
            throw java.io.FileNotFoundException("audio manifest missing: manifest.json")
        }
        val root = json.parseToJsonElement(source.readText("manifest.json")).jsonObject
        sampleRate = (root["sample_rate"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toIntOrNull()) ?: 22050

        val map = mutableMapOf<String, AudioAsset>()
        for (entryElem in root["assets"]?.jsonArray ?: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray(emptyList())) {
            val entry = entryElem.jsonObject
            val id       = entry["id"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content
            val relPath  = entry["path"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content
            val hash     = entry["sha256"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: ""
            val rate     = entry["sample_rate"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toIntOrNull() ?: sampleRate

            if (requireVerified && hash.isEmpty()) {
                throw IntegrityException(
                    "asset $id has no sha256; run tools/generate_audio_assets.py"
                )
            }
            if (!source.exists(relPath)) {
                throw java.io.FileNotFoundException("audio asset missing: $relPath")
            }
            if (hash.isNotEmpty()) {
                val actual = sha256Hex(source.readBytes(relPath))
                if (actual != hash) {
                    throw IntegrityException(
                        "asset $id hash mismatch: $actual != $hash"
                    )
                }
            }
            map[id] = AudioAsset(id = id, relPath = relPath, sha256 = hash, sampleRate = rate)
        }
        assets = map
    }

    fun get(id: String): AudioAsset =
        assets[id] ?: throw kotlin.NoSuchElementException("no audio asset '$id'")

    fun has(id: String): Boolean = id in assets

    fun ids(): List<String> = assets.keys.sorted()

    fun readBytes(asset: AudioAsset): ByteArray = source.readBytes(asset.relPath)

    private fun sha256Hex(bytes: ByteArray): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)
        return digest.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun unusedJsonObject(o: JsonObject) = o
}
```

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Path

/**
 * Abstraction over the platform's native TTS engine.
 *
 * The JVM has no default implementation; the Android module (Batch 10)
 * supplies one backed by android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech.
 *
 * For parity tests, pass `null` — the renderer then uses the deterministic
 * asset backend for every surface.
 */
interface TtsBackend {
    fun isAvailable(): Boolean
    /** Returns true on success. Writes a WAV at [outPath]. */
    fun synthesize(ssml: String, outPath: Path): Boolean
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/WavWriter.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Minimal WAV I/O matching Python's wave-module behavior for mono 16-bit PCM.
 * All click/hum assets are mono 16-bit, so this is sufficient.
 */
object WavWriter {

    data class WavData(val sampleRate: Int, val pcm: ByteArray)

    fun read(path: Path): WavData {
        val bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path)
        require(bytes.size >= 44) { "WAV too short: $path" }
        require(readAscii(bytes, 0, 4) == "RIFF") { "not RIFF: $path" }
        require(readAscii(bytes, 8, 4) == "WAVE") { "not WAVE: $path" }
        require(readAscii(bytes, 12, 4) == "fmt ") { "no fmt chunk: $path" }

        val sampleRate = readUInt32LE(bytes, 24)
        val dataOffset = findChunk(bytes, "data")
        require(dataOffset >= 0) { "no data chunk: $path" }
        val dataSize = readUInt32LE(bytes, dataOffset + 4)
        val start = dataOffset + 8
        val pcm = bytes.copyOfRange(start, start + dataSize)
        return WavData(sampleRate = sampleRate, pcm = pcm)
    }

    fun write(path: Path, sampleRate: Int, pcm: ByteArray) {
        val header = buildHeader(sampleRate, pcm.size)
        path.parent?.let { Files.createDirectories(it) }
        Files.write(path, header + pcm)
    }

    fun toneSamples(token: String, sampleRate: Int): ByteArray {
        val durationS = 0.09
        val n = (sampleRate * durationS).toInt()
        val byteSum = token.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).sumOf { it.toInt() and 0xFF }
        val freq = 180.0 + (byteSum % 220)
        val out = ByteArrayOutputStream(n * 2)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val env = sin(PI * i / n)
            val sample = (12000 * env * sin(2 * PI * freq * i / sampleRate)).toInt()
            out.write(sample and 0xFF)
            out.write((sample shr 8) and 0xFF)
        }
        return out.toByteArray()
    }

    fun durationMs(path: Path): Int = try {
        val d = read(path)
        (1000L * (d.pcm.size / 2) / d.sampleRate).toInt()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        0
    }

    // --- internals ------------------------------------------------------

    private fun readAscii(bytes: ByteArray, off: Int, len: Int): String =
        String(bytes, off, len, Charsets.US_ASCII)

    private fun readUInt32LE(bytes: ByteArray, off: Int): Int =
        (bytes[off].toInt() and 0xFF) or
            ((bytes[off + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((bytes[off + 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or
            ((bytes[off + 3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)

    private fun findChunk(bytes: ByteArray, id: String): Int {
        var i = 12
        while (i + 8 <= bytes.size) {
            val tag = readAscii(bytes, i, 4)
            val size = readUInt32LE(bytes, i + 4)
            if (tag == id) return i
            i += 8 + size + (size and 1)  // chunks are word-aligned
        }
        return -1
    }

    private fun buildHeader(sampleRate: Int, pcmSize: Int): ByteArray {
        val byteRate = sampleRate * 2  // mono 16-bit
        val out = ByteArrayOutputStream(44)
        fun writeAscii(s: String) = out.write(s.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
        fun writeUInt32(v: Int) {
            out.write(v and 0xFF)
            out.write((v shr 8) and 0xFF)
            out.write((v shr 16) and 0xFF)
            out.write((v shr 24) and 0xFF)
        }
        fun writeUInt16(v: Int) {
            out.write(v and 0xFF)
            out.write((v shr 8) and 0xFF)
        }
        writeAscii("RIFF")
        writeUInt32(36 + pcmSize)
        writeAscii("WAVE")
        writeAscii("fmt ")
        writeUInt32(16)
        writeUInt16(1)             // PCM
        writeUInt16(1)             // channels
        writeUInt32(sampleRate)
        writeUInt32(byteRate)
        writeUInt16(2)             // block align
        writeUInt16(16)            // bits per sample
        writeAscii("data")
        writeUInt32(pcmSize)
        return out.toByteArray()
    }
}
```
