## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/TtsRenderer.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

/**
 * Spoken renderer. Bit-identical to Python's TtsRenderer:
 *   - SSML string: byte-for-byte
 *   - phoneme_stream: identical
 *   - backend: "native" when a native backend produced audio, else "asset"
 *   - valid: false only on empty phoneme stream
 *
 * Routing rule (same as Python):
 *   any click or hum token  → asset backend (bundled WAVs)
 *   else                    → native backend if available, else asset
 */
class TtsRenderer(
    private val audio: AudioAssetLibrary,
    private val backend: TtsBackend? = null,
    private val tmpDir: Path = Files.createTempDirectory("oarumi-tts-"),
    private val modality: String = "spoken",
) {

    companion object {
        val CLICK_TOKENS: Set<String> = setOf(
            "ʘ", "ʘ̃", "ʘʰ",
            "ǀ", "ǀ̃", "ǀʰ",
            "ǃ", "ǃ̃", "ǃʰ",
            "ǁ", "ǁ̃", "ǁʰ",
            "ǂ", "ǂ̃", "ǂʰ",
        )
        val HUM_TOKENS: Set<String> = setOf(
            "hum_steady", "hum_pulsed", "hum_rising", "hum_falling",
        )

        private val CLICK_ASSET = mapOf(
            "ʘ"  to "click_bilabial_plain",  "ʘ̃"  to "click_bilabial_nasal",  "ʘʰ"  to "click_bilabial_aspirated",
            "ǀ"  to "click_dental_plain",    "ǀ̃"  to "click_dental_nasal",    "ǀʰ"  to "click_dental_aspirated",
            "ǃ"  to "click_alveolar_plain",  "ǃ̃"  to "click_alveolar_nasal",  "ǃʰ"  to "click_alveolar_aspirated",
            "ǁ"  to "click_lateral_plain",   "ǁ̃"  to "click_lateral_nasal",   "ǁʰ"  to "click_lateral_aspirated",
            "ǂ"  to "click_palatal_plain",   "ǂ̃"  to "click_palatal_nasal",   "ǂʰ"  to "click_palatal_aspirated",
        )

        private val HUM_ASSET = HUM_TOKENS.associateWith { it }
    }

    fun render(surface: OarumiSurface): RenderOutput {
        val stream = surface.phonemes
        if (stream.isEmpty()) {
            return RenderOutput(
                modality = modality,
                payload = mapOf(
                    "phoneme_stream" to JsonArray(emptyList()),
                    "audio_path"     to JsonNull,
                ),
                valid = false,
                errors = listOf("empty_phoneme_stream"),
            )
        }

        val hasSpecial = stream.any { it in CLICK_TOKENS || it in HUM_TOKENS }
        val nativeAvailable = !hasSpecial && backend?.isAvailable() == true
        val routing: String = if (nativeAvailable) "native" else "asset"

        val out = tmpDir.resolve("utterance-${stream.hashCode().toUInt().toString(16)}.wav")

        if (routing == "native") {
            val ssml = buildSsml(surface)
            val ok = backend!!.synthesize(ssml, out) && Files.exists(out)
            if (ok) {
                return successPayload(out, ssml = ssml, stream = stream, backendName = "native")
            }
            // Fall through to asset on failure.
        }

        assetSynthesize(stream, out)
        return successPayload(out, ssml = null, stream = stream, backendName = "asset")
    }

    fun buildSsml(surface: OarumiSurface): String {
        val body = surface.phonemes.joinToString(" ")
        val rate = when (surface.mood) {
            "DECL", "INTERR", "PROM", "EXPRESS" -> "medium"
            "IMPER"                              -> "fast"
            "VOC"                                -> "slow"
            else                                 -> "medium"
        }
        return "<speak version=\"1.1\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis\" " +
               "xml:lang=\"en\"><prosody rate=\"$rate\">$body</prosody></speak>"
    }

    // --- internals ------------------------------------------------------

    private fun successPayload(
        out: Path, ssml: String?, stream: List<String>, backendName: String,
    ): RenderOutput {
        val payload = LinkedHashMap<String, JsonElement>()
        payload["audio_path"]     = JsonPrimitive(out.toString())
        payload["ssml"]           = if (ssml != null) JsonPrimitive(ssml) else JsonNull
        payload["phoneme_stream"] = JsonArray(stream.map { JsonPrimitive(it) })
        payload["backend"]        = JsonPrimitive(backendName)
        payload["duration_ms"]    = JsonPrimitive(WavWriter.durationMs(out))
        return RenderOutput(modality = modality, payload = payload, valid = true)
    }

    private fun assetSynthesize(stream: List<String>, out: Path) {
        val pcm = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
        var sampleRate = audio.sampleRate
        for (token in stream) {
            val assetId: String? = when {
                token in CLICK_TOKENS -> CLICK_ASSET[token]
                token in HUM_TOKENS   -> HUM_ASSET[token]
                else                  -> null
            }
            if (assetId != null) {
                val asset = audio.get(assetId)
                val wav = WavWriter.read(Path.of("").resolve(asset.relPath).let {
                    // Asset bytes are read via the AudioSource abstraction:
                    // write to a temp file so WavWriter.read can parse the header.
                    val tmp = tmpDir.resolve("asset-${asset.id}.wav")
                    if (!Files.exists(tmp)) {
                        Files.createDirectories(tmp.parent)
                        Files.write(tmp, audio.readBytes(asset))
                    }
                    tmp
                })
                sampleRate = wav.sampleRate
                pcm.write(wav.pcm)
            } else {
                pcm.write(WavWriter.toneSamples(token, sampleRate))
            }
        }
        WavWriter.write(out, sampleRate, pcm.toByteArray())
    }
}
```

> The asset-read workaround (`write to tmp, read header`) is deliberate: it keeps `WavWriter` file-based (matching Python) while `AudioSource` stays abstract. An optimized Android backend can cache `WavData` per asset — out of scope for Batch 9.

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/SignRenderer.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface
import org.w3c.dom.Element
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory

/**
 * Bit-identical port of Python's HamNoSysToSigML._builtin + validate_sigml.
 *
 * Emits:
 *   <sigml xmlns="https://vhg.cmp.uea.ac.uk/tech/jas/sigml">
 *     <hns_sign gloss="...">
 *       <hamnosys_manual>
 *         <symbol />
 *         ...
 *       </hamnosys_manual>
 *     </hns_sign>
 *   </sigml>
 *
 * Formatting matches Python's ElementTree.tostring(...) + ET.indent(2 spaces).
 */
class SignRenderer(
    private val useExternal: Boolean = false,
    private val modality: String = "signed",
) {

    companion object {
        const val SIGML_NS = "https://vhg.cmp.uea.ac.uk/tech/jas/sigml"
        private const val SIGML_ROOT = "sigml"
        private const val HNS_SIGN = "hns_sign"
        private const val MANUAL = "hamnosys_manual"

        val ALLOWED_SYMBOLS: Set<String> = setOf(
            "hamfinger2", "hamthumbout", "hamnohandchange", "hamarcsym",
            "hamextfingeru", "hamextfingerd", "hamextfingerl", "hamextfingerr",
            "hampalmd", "hampalmr", "hampalmup", "hampalmdown",
            "hamshoulders", "hamchest", "hamwaist", "hamhead",
            "hammoveo", "hammoveu", "hammoved", "hammovel", "hammover",
            "hamrepeat", "hamplus", "hamsmallmod", "hamlargemod",
            "hamtouch", "hamcircle", "hamstraight",
        )

        private val TOKEN_RE = Regex("""^(?:sym:)?(?<name>ham[a-z0-9_]+)$""")
    }

    fun render(
        surface: OarumiSurface,
        hamnosys: String? = null,
        gloss: String? = null,
    ): RenderOutput {
        val annotation = hamnosys
            ?: "sym:hamfinger2 sym:hamthumbout sym:hamnohandchange sym:hamarcsym sym:hamextfingeru"
        val useGloss = gloss
            ?: surface.phonemes.firstOrNull()
            ?: "UNKNOWN"

        val xml = convert(annotation, useGloss)
        val (ok, errors) = validateSigml(xml)
        return RenderOutput(
            modality = modality,
            payload = mapOf(
                "sigml"     to JsonPrimitive(xml),
                "avatar_ok" to JsonPrimitive(ok),
                "gloss"     to JsonPrimitive(useGloss),
            ),
            valid = ok,
            errors = errors,
        )
    }

    fun convert(annotation: String, gloss: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("<").append(SIGML_ROOT).append(" xmlns=\"").append(SIGML_NS).append("\">\n")
        sb.append("  <").append(HNS_SIGN).append(" gloss=\"").append(escapeAttr(gloss)).append("\">\n")

        val symbols = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String?>>()  // (tag, sym-attr)
        for (raw in annotation.split(Regex("\\s+"))) {
            if (raw.isEmpty()) continue
            val m = TOKEN_RE.matchEntire(raw)
            if (m == null) {
                symbols += "hamunknown" to raw
                continue
            }
            val name = m.groups["name"]!!.value
            if (name !in ALLOWED_SYMBOLS) {
                symbols += "hamunknown" to name
            } else {
                symbols += name to null
            }
        }

        if (symbols.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("    <").append(MANUAL).append(" />\n")
        } else {
            sb.append("    <").append(MANUAL).append(">\n")
            for ((tag, sym) in symbols) {
                sb.append("      <").append(tag)
                if (sym != null) {
                    sb.append(" sym=\"").append(escapeAttr(sym)).append("\"")
                }
                sb.append(" />\n")
            }
            sb.append("    </").append(MANUAL).append(">\n")
        }

        sb.append("  </").append(HNS_SIGN).append(">\n")
        sb.append("</").append(SIGML_ROOT).append(">")
        return sb.toString()
    }

    private fun escapeAttr(s: String): String = buildString {
        for (c in s) {
            when (c) {
                '&'  -> append("&amp;")
                '<'  -> append("&lt;")
                '>'  -> append("&gt;")
                '"'  -> append("&quot;")
                else -> append(c)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateSigml(xml: String): Pair<Boolean, List<String>> {
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        val doc = try {
            DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance()
                .newDocumentBuilder()
                .parse(xml.byteInputStream())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return false to listOf("parse_error:${e.message}")
        }
        val root = doc.documentElement
        if (root.tagName != SIGML_ROOT) errors += "root:${root.tagName}"
        val signs = root.getElementsByTagName(HNS_SIGN)
        if (signs.length != 1) {
            errors += "hns_sign_count:${signs.length}"
            return (errors.isEmpty()) to errors
        }
        val sign = signs.item(0) as Element
        if (!sign.hasAttribute("gloss")) errors += "hns_sign:missing_gloss"
        val manuals = sign.getElementsByTagName(MANUAL)
        if (manuals.length != 1) {
            errors += "hamnosys_manual:missing"
            return (errors.isEmpty()) to errors
        }
        val manual = manuals.item(0) as Element
        val children = manual.childNodes
        for (i in 0 until children.length) {
            val node = children.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
            val name = node.tagName
            if (name == "hamunknown") {
                errors += "unknown_symbol:${node.getAttribute("sym")}"
            } else if (name !in ALLOWED_SYMBOLS) {
                errors += "unexpected_element:$name"
            }
        }
        return (errors.isEmpty()) to errors
    }
}
```

## `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/TactileRenderer.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

/**
 * Bit-identical port of Python's TactileRenderer.
 *
 * The `_select` decision tree and `_referent_id` hashing are the two
 * deterministic pieces the parity test compares.
 */
class TactileRenderer(private val modality: String = "tactile") {

    companion object {
        val CONSTRUCTIONS: Map<String, Map<String, String>> = mapOf(
            "T001" to mapOf(
                "conveyer_hand"     to "right",
                "receiver_location" to "left_forearm",
                "movement"          to "linear",
                "contact"           to "light",
                "gloss"             to "referent_established",
            ),
            "T002" to mapOf(
                "conveyer_hand"     to "left",
                "receiver_location" to "right_forearm",
                "movement"          to "circular",
                "contact"           to "firm",
                "gloss"             to "location_here",
            ),
            "T003" to mapOf(
                "conveyer_hand"     to "both",
                "receiver_location" to "chest",
                "movement"          to "tap",
                "contact"           to "light",
                "gloss"             to "self_reference",
            ),
            "T004" to mapOf(
                "conveyer_hand"     to "right",
                "receiver_location" to "left_palm",
                "movement"          to "hold",
                "contact"           to "firm",
                "gloss"             to "object_given",
            ),
            "T005" to mapOf(
                "conveyer_hand"     to "left",
                "receiver_location" to "right_shoulder",
                "movement"          to "press",
                "contact"           to "firm",
                "gloss"             to "attention_request",
            ),
        )
    }

    fun render(surface: OarumiSurface): RenderOutput {
        val cid = select(surface)
        val base = CONSTRUCTIONS[cid]!!
        val protocol = linkedMapOf<String, JsonPrimitive>(
            "construction_id"   to JsonPrimitive(cid),
            "conveyer_hand"     to JsonPrimitive(base["conveyer_hand"]),
            "receiver_location" to JsonPrimitive(base["receiver_location"]),
            "movement"          to JsonPrimitive(base["movement"]),
            "contact"           to JsonPrimitive(base["contact"]),
            "referent_id"       to JsonPrimitive(referentId(surface)),
            "gloss"             to JsonPrimitive(base["gloss"]),
        )
        val errors = validate(protocol.mapValues { (_, v) -> v.content })
        return RenderOutput(
            modality = modality,
            payload = mapOf("protocol" to JsonObject(protocol)),
            valid = errors.isEmpty(),
            errors = errors,
        )
    }

    private fun select(surface: OarumiSurface): String {
        val forms  = surface.clitics.map { it.type }.toSet()
        val tokens = surface.phonemes.toSet()
        if (surface.mood == "INTERR") {
            return if ("lonu" in tokens || "where" in tokens) "T002" else "T005"
        }
        if (surface.mood == "IMPER")   return "T004"
        if (surface.mood == "PROM")    return "T003"
        if (surface.mood == "EXPRESS") return "T005"
        if (surface.mood == "VOC")     return "T003"
        if ("mood_declarative" in forms) return "T001"
        return "T001"
    }

    private fun referentId(surface: OarumiSurface): String {
        val joined = surface.phonemes.joinToString("|")
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(joined.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val hex = digest.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        return "r${hex.take(8)}"
    }

    private fun validate(fields: Map<String, String>): List<String> {
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        val required = setOf(
            "construction_id", "conveyer_hand", "receiver_location",
            "movement", "contact", "referent_id",
        )
        for (k in required) if (k !in fields) errors += "missing:$k"
        if (fields["conveyer_hand"] !in setOf("left", "right", "both"))
            errors += "bad_conveyer_hand"
        if (fields["contact"] !in setOf("light", "firm"))
            errors += "bad_contact"
        return errors
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/AudioAssetLibraryTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue
import oarumi.errors.IntegrityException

class AudioAssetLibraryTest {

    private val assetDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")).resolve("../assets/audio").normalize()

    @Test
    fun `manifest_has_19_assets`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json")),
            "run tools/generate_audio_assets.py first")
        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        assertEquals(19, lib.ids().size)
    }

    @Test
    fun `all_hashes_verify_when_present`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json")))
        // Only run when hashes are populated; otherwise skip (dev mode).
        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        val hasHashes = lib.ids().all { lib.get(it).sha256.isNotEmpty() }
        assumeTrue(hasHashes, "manifest has empty hashes; run tools/generate_audio_assets.py")
        // Re-instantiate with verification on — must not throw.
        AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = true)
    }

    @Test
    fun `corrupted_asset_raises`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json")))
        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        val anyAsset = lib.get(lib.ids().first())
        assumeTrue(anyAsset.sha256.isNotEmpty(), "manifest has empty hashes")

        // Copy the bundle to a temp dir, corrupt one file, verify rejection.
        val tmp = Files.createTempDirectory("audio-corrupt-")
        Files.copy(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json"), tmp.resolve("manifest.json"))
        for (id in lib.ids()) {
            val asset = lib.get(id)
            val target = tmp.resolve(asset.relPath)
            target.parent?.let { Files.createDirectories(it) }
            Files.copy(assetDir.resolve(asset.relPath), target)
        }
        Files.write(tmp.resolve(anyAsset.relPath), "corrupted".toByteArray())

        assertFailsWith<IntegrityException> {
            AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(tmp), requireVerified = true)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `missing_manifest_raises`() {
        val tmp = Files.createTempDirectory("audio-empty-")
        assertFailsWith<java.io.FileNotFoundException> {
            AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(tmp))
        }
    }
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/TtsRendererTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue
import oarumi.types.Clitic
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

class TtsRendererTest {

    private val assetDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")).resolve("../assets/audio").normalize()

    private fun renderer(): TtsRenderer {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json")),
            "run tools/generate_audio_assets.py first")
        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        return TtsRenderer(audio = lib, backend = null)
    }

    private fun surface(vararg phonemes: String, mood: String = "DECL"): OarumiSurface =
        OarumiSurface(
            phonemes = phonemes.toList(),
            clitics = listOf(Clitic("=ha", "mood_declarative")),
            mood = mood,
            modality = "spoken",
        )

    @Test
    fun `click routes to asset backend and produces a playable wav`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val out = r.render(surface("ʘ", "a"))
        assertTrue(out.valid, "expected valid, errors=${out.errors}")
        assertEquals("asset", (out.payload["backend"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content)
        val path = Path.of((out.payload["audio_path"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content)
        assertTrue(Files.exists(path))
        assertTrue(Files.size(path) > 44)  // header + samples
        val dur = WavWriter.durationMs(path)
        assertTrue(dur > 0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `hum routes to asset backend`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val out = r.render(surface("hum_rising", "hello"))
        assertTrue(out.valid)
        assertEquals("asset", (out.payload["backend"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `plain falls back to asset when no native backend`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val out = r.render(surface("hello"))
        assertTrue(out.valid)
        assertEquals("asset", (out.payload["backend"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `empty surface is invalid`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val out = r.render(surface())
        assertEquals(false, out.valid)
        assertTrue("empty_phoneme_stream" in out.errors)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ssml shape matches python`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val ssml = r.buildSsml(surface("hello", mood = "INTERR"))
        assertEquals(
            "<speak version=\"1.1\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis\" " +
            "xml:lang=\"en\"><prosody rate=\"medium\">hello</prosody></speak>",
            ssml,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `ssml rate for imper is fast`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val ssml = r.buildSsml(surface("come", mood = "IMPER"))
        assertTrue("rate=\"fast\"" in ssml)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ssml rate for voc is slow`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val ssml = r.buildSsml(surface("you", mood = "VOC"))
        assertTrue("rate=\"slow\"" in ssml)
    }

    @Test
    fun `no native backend means ssml is null`() {
        val r = renderer()
        val out = r.render(surface("ʘ", "a"))
        assertNull(out.payload["ssml"]?.let { if (it is kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonNull) null else it })
    }

    @Test
    fun `fake native backend is used for plain surfaces`() {
        val fake = object : TtsBackend {
            override fun isAvailable() = true
            override fun synthesize(ssml: String, outPath: Path): Boolean {
                WavWriter.write(outPath, 22050, ByteArray(4000))
                return true
            }
        }
        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        val r = TtsRenderer(audio = lib, backend = fake)
        val out = r.render(surface("hello"))
        assertEquals("native", (out.payload["backend"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content)
        assertNotNull(out.payload["ssml"])
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import oarumi.types.Clitic
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

class SignRendererTest {

    private fun surface(): OarumiSurface = OarumiSurface(
        phonemes = listOf("manu"),
        clitics = listOf(Clitic("=ha", "mood_declarative")),
        mood = "DECL",
        modality = "signed",
    )

    @Test
    fun `default annotation produces valid sigml`() {
        val out = SignRenderer().render(surface())
        assertTrue(out.valid, "errors=${out.errors}")
        assertEquals(true, (out.payload["avatar_ok"] as kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive).content.toBoolean())
    }

    @Test
    fun `xml format matches python exactly`() {
        val r = SignRenderer()
        val xml = r.convert("sym:hamfinger2", "test")
        val expected =
            "<sigml xmlns=\"https://vhg.cmp.uea.ac.uk/tech/jas/sigml\">\n" +
            "  <hns_sign gloss=\"test\">\n" +
            "    <hamnosys_manual>\n" +
            "      <hamfinger2 />\n" +
            "    </hamnosys_manual>\n" +
            "  </hns_sign>\n" +
            "</sigml>"
        assertEquals(expected, xml)
    }

    @Test
    fun `empty annotation produces self-closing manual`() {
        val r = SignRenderer()
        val xml = r.convert("", "test")
        val expected =
            "<sigml xmlns=\"https://vhg.cmp.uea.ac.uk/tech/jas/sigml\">\n" +
            "  <hns_sign gloss=\"test\">\n" +
            "    <hamnosys_manual />\n" +
            "  </hns_sign>\n" +
            "</sigml>"
        assertEquals(expected, xml)
    }

    @Test
    fun `unknown symbol appears as hamunknown`() {
        val r = SignRenderer()
        val xml = r.convert("sym:hamnotarealsymbol", "test")
        assertTrue("hamunknown" in xml)
        assertTrue("sym=\"hamnotarealsymbol\"" in xml)
    }

    @Test
    fun `validate rejects unknown symbol`() {
        val out = SignRenderer().render(surface(), hamnosys = "sym:hamnotarealsymbol")
        assertEquals(false, out.valid)
        assertTrue(out.errors.any { "unknown_symbol" in it })
    }

    @Test
    fun `attribute escaping`() {
        val r = SignRenderer()
        val xml = r.convert("sym:hamfinger2", "a<b&c\"d")
        assertTrue("gloss=\"a&lt;b&amp;c&quot;d\"" in xml)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import oarumi.types.Clitic
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

class TactileRendererTest {

    private fun surface(
        mood: String, phonemes: List<String>, cliticType: String,
    ): OarumiSurface = OarumiSurface(
        phonemes = phonemes,
        clitics = listOf(Clitic("=x", cliticType)),
        mood = mood,
        modality = "tactile",
    )

    @Test
    fun `decl selects T001`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("DECL", listOf("hello"), "mood_declarative")
        )
        assertTrue(out.valid)
        assertEquals("T001", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `interr_where selects T002`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("INTERR", listOf("lonu", "bath"), "mood_interrogative")
        )
        assertEquals("T002", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `interr_who selects T005`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("INTERR", listOf("who"), "mood_interrogative")
        )
        assertEquals("T005", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `imper selects T004`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("IMPER", listOf("come"), "mood_imperative")
        )
        assertEquals("T004", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `prom selects T003`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("PROM", listOf("i"), "mood_promissive")
        )
        assertEquals("T003", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `express selects T005`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(
            surface("EXPRESS", listOf("thanks"), "mood_expressive")
        )
        assertEquals("T005", (protocolOf(out)["construction_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content)
    }

    @Test
    fun `referent is deterministic`() {
        val a = TactileRenderer().render(surface("DECL", listOf("hello"), "mood_declarative"))
        val b = TactileRenderer().render(surface("DECL", listOf("hello"), "mood_declarative"))
        assertEquals(
            (protocolOf(a)["referent_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content,
            (protocolOf(b)["referent_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `referent id has correct shape`() {
        val out = TactileRenderer().render(surface("DECL", listOf("hello"), "mood_declarative"))
        val ref = (protocolOf(out)["referent_id"] as JsonPrimitive).content
        assertTrue(Regex("^r[0-9a-f]{8}$").matches(ref), "got: $ref")
    }

    private fun protocolOf(out: RenderOutput): JsonObject =
        out.payload["protocol"] as JsonObject
}
```

### `engine/kotlin/src/test/kotlin/oarumi/renderers/CrossLanguageTtsTest.kt`

```kotlin
package oarumi.renderers

import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.io.path.extension
import kotlin.io.path.readText
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue
import oarumi.types.Clitic
import oarumi.types.OarumiSurface

class CrossLanguageTtsTest {

    private val fixturesDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("oarumi.parity.data") ?: "../tests/parity/data")
            .resolve("renderers/tts")

    private val assetDir: Path =
        Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")).resolve("../assets/audio").normalize()

    @Test
    fun `kotlin tts output matches frozen gold`() {
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(fixturesDir.resolve("cases.json")), "no tts fixtures")
        assumeTrue(Files.exists(assetDir.resolve("manifest.json")), "run generate_audio_assets.py")

        val lib = AudioAssetLibrary(FileSystemAudioSource(assetDir), requireVerified = false)
        val renderer = TtsRenderer(audio = lib, backend = null)

        val cases = Json.parseToJsonElement(
            fixturesDir.resolve("cases.json").readText()
        ).jsonObject["cases"]!!.jsonArray

        for (caseElem in cases) {
            val case = caseElem.jsonObject
            val id = case["id"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content
            val surface = surfaceFromJson(case["surface"]!!.jsonObject)
            val got = renderer.render(surface).toJsonObject()

            val goldFile = fixturesDir.resolve("gold").resolve("$id.json")
            assumeTrue(Files.exists(goldFile),
                "no gold for $id — run the Python freeze step first")

            val expected = Json.parseToJsonElement(goldFile.readText()).jsonObject
            val gotCanonical      = canonical(got)
            val expectedCanonical = canonical(expected)
            assertEquals(expectedCanonical, gotCanonical, "case=$id")
        }
    }

    private fun surfaceFromJson(obj: JsonObject): OarumiSurface {
        return OarumiSurface(
            phonemes = obj["phonemes"]!!.jsonArray.map { it.jsonPrimitive.content },
            clitics = obj["clitics"]!!.jsonArray.map {
                val c = it.jsonObject
                Clitic(
                    form = c["form"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
                    type = c["type"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
                )
            },
            mood = obj["mood"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
            modality = obj["modality"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content,
        )
    }

    private fun canonical(elem: JsonElement): JsonElement {
        val obj = elem.jsonObject.toMutableMap()
        obj.remove("audio_path")
        obj.remove("duration_ms")
        obj["backend"]?.let {
            val s = it.jsonPrimitive.content
            if (s in setOf("espeak", "android", "native")) {
                obj["backend"] = JsonPrimitive("native")
            }
        }
        return JsonObject(obj)
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun unusedJsonNull(n: JsonNull) = n
}
```

## Freezing gold (Python side)

Add to `tools/freeze_gold.py` (or run interactively):

```python
# tools/freeze_renderer_gold.py — new file for this batch
"""Freeze renderer parity gold from the Python implementation. Idempotent."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FIXTURES = ROOT / "tests" / "parity" / "data" / "renderers"


def freeze_tts() -> int:
    from oarumi.renderers.audio_assets import AudioAssetLibrary
    from oarumi.renderers.tts import TtsRenderer
    from oarumi.types import Clitic, OarumiSurface

    assets = AudioAssetLibrary(ROOT / "assets" / "audio", require_verified=False)
    renderer = TtsRenderer(audio=assets, espeak_bin=None)
    renderer.espeak_bin = None  # force asset backend for determinism

    cases = json.loads((FIXTURES / "tts" / "cases.json").read_text())
    (FIXTURES / "tts" / "gold").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    for case in cases["cases"]:
        surf = case["surface"]
        surface = OarumiSurface(
            phonemes=tuple(surf["phonemes"]),
            clitics=tuple(Clitic(c["form"], c["type"]) for c in surf["clitics"]),
            mood=surf["mood"],
            modality=surf["modality"],
        )
        out = renderer.render(surface).to_json()
        out.pop("audio_path", None)
        out.pop("duration_ms", None)
        if out.get("backend") in ("espeak", "android", "native"):
            out["backend"] = "native"
        (FIXTURES / "tts" / "gold" / f"{case['id']}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
        )
    return len(cases["cases"])


def freeze_sign() -> int:
    from oarumi.renderers.sign import HamNoSysToSigML, SignRenderer
    from oarumi.types import Clitic, OarumiSurface

    renderer = SignRenderer(converter=HamNoSysToSigML(use_external=False))
    cases = json.loads((FIXTURES / "sign" / "cases.json").read_text())
    (FIXTURES / "sign" / "gold").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    for case in cases["cases"]:
        gloss = case["gloss"]
        annot = case["annotation"]
        surface = OarumiSurface(
            phonemes=(gloss,),
            clitics=(Clitic("=ha", "mood_declarative"),),
            mood="DECL", modality="signed",
        )
        out = renderer.render(surface, hamnosys=annot, gloss=gloss).to_json()
        (FIXTURES / "sign" / "gold" / f"{case['id']}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
        )
    return len(cases["cases"])


def freeze_tactile() -> int:
    from oarumi.renderers.tactile import TactileRenderer
    from oarumi.types import Clitic, OarumiSurface

    renderer = TactileRenderer()
    cases = json.loads((FIXTURES / "tactile" / "cases.json").read_text())
    (FIXTURES / "tactile" / "gold").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    for case in cases["cases"]:
        surf = case["surface"]
        surface = OarumiSurface(
            phonemes=tuple(surf["phonemes"]),
            clitics=tuple(Clitic(c["form"], c["type"]) for c in surf["clitics"]),
            mood=surf["mood"], modality=surf["modality"],
        )
        out = renderer.render(surface).to_json()
        (FIXTURES / "tactile" / "gold" / f"{case['id']}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
        )
    return len(cases["cases"])


def main() -> int:
    tts_n = freeze_tts()
    sign_n = freeze_sign()
    tactile_n = freeze_tactile()
    print(f"OK   froze tts={tts_n} sign={sign_n} tactile={tactile_n}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

### 0.1 `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/db/LanguageStore.kt` — new interface

```kotlin
package oarumi.db

/**
 * Contract shared by the JVM (LanguageDb, JDBC) and Android (AndroidLanguageStore,
 * Room) implementations. Every consumer in the engine depends on this interface,
 * never on the concrete class.
 */
interface LanguageStore : AutoCloseable {
    fun getPrime(pid: String): Prime?
    fun allPrimes(): List<Prime>
    fun searchLexemes(query: String, limit: Int = 20): List<Lexeme>
    fun getLexemeByPhon(phon: String): Lexeme?
    fun getGold(component: String, inputHash: String): String?
}
```

### 0.2 `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/db/LanguageDb.kt` — implement the interface

Append these two methods to `LanguageDb` and add `: LanguageStore` to the class declaration:

```kotlin
class LanguageDb(path: Path) : LanguageStore {
    // ... existing body unchanged, plus:

    override fun getLexemeByPhon(phon: String): Lexeme? =
        conn.prepareStatement(
            """SELECT id, phon_form, click, tone, gloss, root_class, frequency
               FROM lexemes WHERE phon_form = ?"""
        ).use { ps ->
            ps.setString(1, phon)
            ps.executeQuery().use { rs ->
                if (rs.next()) Lexeme(
                    id        = rs.getInt("id"),
                    phonForm  = rs.getString("phon_form"),
                    click     = rs.getString("click"),
                    tone      = rs.getString("tone"),
                    gloss     = rs.getString("gloss"),
                    rootClass = rs.getString("root_class"),
                    frequency = rs.getInt("frequency"),
                ) else null
            }
        }

    override fun getGold(component: String, inputHash: String): String? =
        conn.prepareStatement(
            "SELECT output_json FROM parity_gold WHERE component = ? AND input_hash = ?"
        ).use { ps ->
            ps.setString(1, component); ps.setString(2, inputHash)
            ps.executeQuery().use { rs -> if (rs.next()) rs.getString(1) else null }
        }

    override fun close() {
        super.close()
        conn.close()
    }
```

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.db

import androidx.room.ColumnInfo
import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey

/**
 * Room entities mirror language/schema.sql column-for-column.
 * Do not rename columns; the JVM LanguageDb reads the same rows.
 */
@Entity(tableName = "primes")
data class PrimeEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "gloss")       val gloss: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "category")    val category: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "combinators") val combinators: String,   // JSON array string
    @ColumnInfo(name = "spoken_form") val spokenForm: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "signed_form") val signedForm: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "tactile_form") val tactileForm: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "nsm_version") val nsmVersion: String,
)

@Entity(tableName = "lexemes")
data class LexemeEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "phon_form")  val phonForm: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "click")      val click: String?,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "tone")       val tone: String?,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "gloss")      val gloss: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "root_class") val rootClass: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "frequency")  val frequency: Int,
)

@Entity(tableName = "senses")
data class SenseEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "lexeme_id")    val lexemeId: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "prime_decomp") val primeDecomp: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "gloss")        val gloss: String,
)

@Entity(tableName = "signs")
data class SignEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "lexeme_id") val lexemeId: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "hamnosys")  val hamnosys: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "nonmanual") val nonmanual: String,
)

@Entity(tableName = "tactile")
data class TactileEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "sign_id")       val signId: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "protocol_json") val protocolJson: String,
)

@Entity(tableName = "parity_gold")
data class GoldEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: Int,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "component")   val component: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "input_hash")  val inputHash: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "output_json") val outputJson: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "frozen_at")   val frozenAt: String,
)

@Entity(tableName = "schema_migrations")
data class MigrationEntity(
    @PrimaryKey @ColumnInfo(name = "id") val id: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "applied_at") val appliedAt: String,
    @ColumnInfo(name = "checksum")   val checksum: String,
)
```

## `android/app/src/main/java/com/oarumi/app/data/db/Daos.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.db

import androidx.room.Dao
import androidx.room.Query

@Dao
interface PrimeDao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM primes WHERE id = :id")
    fun getById(id: String): PrimeEntity?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM primes ORDER BY id ASC")
    fun all(): List<PrimeEntity>
}

@Dao
interface LexemeDao {
    @Query(
        """
        SELECT * FROM lexemes
        WHERE phon_form LIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR gloss LIKE '%' || :query || '%'
        ORDER BY frequency DESC, id ASC
        LIMIT :limit
        """
    )
    fun search(query: String, limit: Int): List<LexemeEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM lexemes WHERE phon_form = :phon LIMIT 1")
    fun byPhon(phon: String): LexemeEntity?
}

@Dao
interface SignDao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM signs WHERE lexeme_id = :lexemeId LIMIT 1")
    fun byLexeme(lexemeId: Int): SignEntity?
}

@Dao
interface TactileDao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM tactile WHERE sign_id = :signId")
    fun bySign(signId: Int): List<TactileEntity>
}

@Dao
interface GoldDao {
    @Query(
        "SELECT output_json FROM parity_gold WHERE component = :component AND input_hash = :hash LIMIT 1"
    )
    fun output(component: String, hash: String): String?
}
```

## `android/app/src/main/java/com/oarumi/app/data/db/AppDatabase.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.db

import android.content.Context
import androidx.room.Database
import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase

@Database(
    entities = [
        PrimeEntity::class,
        LexemeEntity::class,
        SenseEntity::class,
        SignEntity::class,
        TactileEntity::class,
        GoldEntity::class,
        MigrationEntity::class,
    ],
    version = 1,
    exportSchema = true,
)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun primeDao(): PrimeDao
    abstract fun lexemeDao(): LexemeDao
    abstract fun signDao(): SignDao
    abstract fun tactileDao(): TactileDao
    abstract fun goldDao(): GoldDao

    companion object {
        const val DB_NAME = "oarumi.db"

        /**
         * Open the pre-seeded database from assets. createFromAsset copies the
         * file into databases/ on first run; subsequent runs reuse the copy.
         * The copy is never modified by the app.
         */
        fun create(context: Context): AppDatabase =
            Room.databaseBuilder(context, AppDatabase::class.java, DB_NAME)
                .createFromAsset(DB_NAME)
                .fallbackToDestructiveMigration()
                .build()
    }
}
```

## `android/app/src/main/java/com/oarumi/app/data/db/AndroidLanguageStore.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.db

import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import oarumi.db.LanguageStore
import oarumi.db.Lexeme
import oarumi.db.Prime
import oarumi.types.OarumiJson

/**
 * Room-backed implementation of the engine's LanguageStore.
 * Field names and behavior match LanguageDb (JVM); parity is enforced by tests.
 */
class AndroidLanguageStore(private val db: AppDatabase) : LanguageStore {

    override fun getPrime(pid: String): Prime? =
        db.primeDao().getById(pid)?.let(::toPrime)

    override fun allPrimes(): List<Prime> =
        db.primeDao().all().map(::toPrime)

    override fun searchLexemes(query: String, limit: Int): List<Lexeme> =
        db.lexemeDao().search(query, limit).map(::toLexeme)

    override fun getLexemeByPhon(phon: String): Lexeme? =
        db.lexemeDao().byPhon(phon)?.let(::toLexeme)

    override fun getGold(component: String, inputHash: String): String? =
        db.goldDao().output(component, inputHash)

    override fun close() {
        // Room owns the connection; closing happens when the DB is destroyed.
    }

    private fun toPrime(e: PrimeEntity): Prime {
        val combinators = OarumiJson
            .parseToJsonElement(e.combinators)
            .jsonArray
            .map { it.jsonPrimitive.content }
        return Prime(
            id          = e.id,
            gloss       = e.gloss,
            category    = e.category,
            combinators = combinators,
            spokenForm  = e.spokenForm,
            signedForm  = e.signedForm,
            tactileForm = e.tactileForm,
            nsmVersion  = e.nsmVersion,
        )
    }

    private fun toLexeme(e: LexemeEntity): Lexeme = Lexeme(
        id        = e.id,
        phonForm  = e.phonForm,
        click     = e.click,
        tone      = e.tone,
        gloss     = e.gloss,
        rootClass = e.rootClass,
```

## `android/app/src/main/java/com/oarumi/app/data/mlkit/MlKitTranslator.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.mlkit

import android.content.Context
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task
import com.google.mlkit.common.model.DownloadConditions
import com.google.mlkit.nl.translate.TranslateLanguage
import com.google.mlkit.nl.translate.Translation
import com.google.mlkit.nl.translate.Translator
import com.google.mlkit.nl.translate.TranslatorOptions
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import oarumi.errors.CapabilityMissingException
import oarumi.errors.OfflineException

/**
 * Offline pivot translation backed by Google ML Kit on-device translation.
 *
 * Model download is explicit (never on the hot path). After download, translate()
 * runs entirely on-device. ML Kit uses English as the intermediate language for
 * non-English pairs; this matches the Oarumi pivot architecture.
 */
class MlKitTranslator(private val context: Context) {

    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private val translators = mutableMapOf<String, Translator>()  // key: "src>en"

    /** Languages that ML Kit supports for on-device translation. */
    fun supportedLanguages(): Set<String> = TranslateLanguage.getAllLanguages()

    /** True if the model for this language is already downloaded. */
    suspend fun isDownloaded(sourceLang: String): Boolean {
        val translator = obtain(sourceLang) ?: return false
        return suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            translator.downloadModelIfNeeded(DownloadConditions.Builder().build())
                .addOnSuccessListener { cont.resume(true) }
                .addOnFailureListener { cont.resume(false) }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Download (or verify) the model for [sourceLang]. Idempotent.
     * Call from the bootstrap wizard, never from translate().
     */
    suspend fun ensureModel(sourceLang: String): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        val translator = translators.getOrPut("$sourceLang>en") {
            val opts = TranslatorOptions.Builder()
                .setSourceLanguage(sourceLang)
                .setTargetLanguage(TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH)
                .build()
            Translation.getClient(opts)
        }
        try {
            await(translator.downloadModelIfNeeded(DownloadConditions.Builder().build()))
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Translate [text] to English. Throws CapabilityMissingException when the
     * model is not installed; throws OfflineException if the caller's offline
     * mode would forbid the underlying ML Kit call (ML Kit itself works
     * offline once the model is present, so this path is only for callers
     * that want a hard guarantee).
     */
    suspend fun translate(text: String, sourceLang: String, offline: Boolean = false): String {
        if (text.isBlank()) return ""
        if (sourceLang == TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH) return text
        if (sourceLang !in supportedLanguages()) {
            throw CapabilityMissingException(
                "ML Kit does not support '$sourceLang'",
                capability = "mlkit:${sourceLang}",
            )
        }
        val translator = obtain(sourceLang)
            ?: throw CapabilityMissingException(
                "no translator for '$sourceLang'", capability = "mlkit:${sourceLang}",
            )
        // ML Kit's translate is safe offline once the model is downloaded; the
        // `offline` parameter is retained for the interface but not used to gate.
        @Suppress("UNUSED_EXPRESSION") offline
        return await(translator.translate(text))
    }

    fun close() {
        translators.values.forEach { it.close() }
        translators.clear()
    }

    // --- internals ------------------------------------------------------

    private fun obtain(sourceLang: String): Translator? {
        if (sourceLang == TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH) return null
        return translators.getOrPut("$sourceLang>en") {
            val opts = TranslatorOptions.Builder()
                .setSourceLanguage(sourceLang)
                .setTargetLanguage(TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH)
                .build()
            Translation.getClient(opts)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun <T> await(task: Task<T>): T =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            task.addOnSuccessListener { value -> cont.resume(value) }
                .addOnFailureListener { e -> cont.resumeWithException(e) }
        }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.audio

import android.content.res.AssetManager
import oarumi.renderers.AudioSource

/**
 * AudioSource implementation backed by the APK's assets/ folder.
 * The path convention (assets/audio/...) matches the JVM FileSystemAudioSource
 * rooted at the repo's assets/audio directory.
 */
class AndroidAudioSource(private val assets: AssetManager) : AudioSource {
    override fun exists(relPath: String): Boolean = try {
        assets.open("audio/$relPath").use { true }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        false
    }

    override fun readText(relPath: String): String =
        assets.open("audio/$relPath").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }

    override fun readBytes(relPath: String): ByteArray =
        assets.open("audio/$relPath").use { it.readBytes() }
}
```

## `android/app/src/main/java/com/oarumi/app/data/tts/AndroidTtsBackend.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.tts

import android.content.Context
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import oarumi.renderers.TtsBackend

/**
 * TtsBackend implementation using android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech.
 *
 * Important: TTS initialization is asynchronous and can fail (missing engine,
 * no offline voices). The renderer treats isAvailable() == false as "use the
 * asset backend", which is deterministic and always works.
 *
 * synthesizeToFile() respects SSML when the engine supports it. The asset
 * backend (TtsRenderer.assetSynthesize) handles clicks and hums, so this class
 * is only ever asked to render plain phoneme streams.
 */
class AndroidTtsBackend(context: Context) : TtsBackend, AutoCloseable {

    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private var engine: TextToSpeech? = null
    @Volatile private var ready = false
    @Volatile private var failed = false
    private val initLock = Object()

    init {
        startInit()
    }

    private fun startInit() {
        engine = TextToSpeech(appContext) { status ->
            synchronized(initLock) {
                ready = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS &&
                        engine?.setLanguage(Locale.ENGLISH) != TextToSpeech.LANG_MISSING_DATA &&
                        engine?.setLanguage(Locale.ENGLISH) != TextToSpeech.LANG_NOT_SUPPORTED
                failed = !ready
            }
        }
    }

    /** Waits up to 2 s for engine init. Called once at app startup; safe to re-call. */
    suspend fun awaitReady(timeoutMs: Long = 2_000L): Boolean {
        if (ready) return true
        if (failed) return false
        val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeoutMs
        while (System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
            synchronized(initLock) { if (ready || failed) return ready }
            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(20)
        }
        synchronized(initLock) { failed = true }
        return false
    }

    override fun isAvailable(): Boolean = ready && !failed

    override fun synthesize(ssml: String, outPath: Path): Boolean {
        val e = engine ?: return false
        if (!isAvailable()) return false
        val target = File(outPath.toString())
        target.parentFile?.mkdirs()

        val token = "oarumi-" + UUID.randomUUID()

        // Block until the utterance completes or fails. The caller (TtsRenderer)
        // is on a background dispatcher; blocking here is acceptable and
        // simplifies the renderer's contract.
        val done = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)
        @Volatile var success = false

        e.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(object : UtteranceProgressListener() {
            override fun onStart(utteranceId: String?) {}
            override fun onDone(utteranceId: String?) {
                if (utteranceId == token) { success = true; done.countDown() }
            }
            @Deprecated("Deprecated in API 21; required override")
            override fun onError(utteranceId: String?) {
                if (utteranceId == token) { success = false; done.countDown() }
            }
            override fun onError(utteranceId: String?, errorCode: Int) {
                if (utteranceId == token) { success = false; done.countDown() }
            }
        })

        val result = e.synthesizeToFile(ssml, null, target, token)
        if (result != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) return false

        val ok = done.await(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        return ok && success && target.exists() && target.length() > 44
    }

    override fun close() {
        engine?.stop()
        engine?.shutdown()
        engine = null
        ready = false
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private suspend fun unusedSuspend(cb: suspend () -> Unit) =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine<Unit> { cont -> cont.resume(Unit) }
}
```

> The `@Volatile` on a local is illegal in Kotlin; it only applies to class members. The `synthesize()` body above needs a small fix: replace `@Volatile var success = false` with a captured `AtomicBoolean`:

```kotlin
        val success = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        // ...
            override fun onDone(utteranceId: String?) {
                if (utteranceId == token) { success.set(true); done.countDown() }
            }
        // ...
        return ok && success.get() && target.exists() && target.length() > 44
```

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.avatar

import android.webkit.WebView
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Manages a WebView hosting the CWASA SiGML viewer.
 *
 * The asset HTML at assets/avatar/index.html defines window.playSigML(xml).
 * This class is the type-safe bridge; the WebView is created and owned by
 * the Compose layer (Batch 11).
 */
class CwasaController {

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = false }

    fun attach(webView: WebView) {
        webView.settings.apply {
            javaScriptEnabled = true
            allowFileAccess = true
            allowContentAccess = false
            domStorageEnabled = false  // not needed; keeps sandbox tight
        }
        webView.loadUrl("file:///android_asset/avatar/index.html")
    }

    /**
     * Injects the SiGML into the page. The page must have finished loading
     * (onPageFinished fires first). Callers should queue if necessary; the
     * Compose layer in Batch 11 does this with a LaunchedEffect.
     */
    fun play(webView: WebView, sigml: String) {
        val payload = json.encodeToString(String.serializer(), sigml)
        webView.evaluateJavascript("window.playSigML($payload);", null)
    }

    fun clear(webView: WebView) {
        webView.evaluateJavascript("window.playSigML('');", null)
    }
}

private object StringSerializer
private val String.serializer get() = kotlinx.serialization.builtins.serializer<String>()

/** Local typealias so the Kotlin engine does not need a Compose dependency. */
private typealias JsonStringSerializer = kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer<String>
```

> Simpler alternative: use `Json.encodeToString(sigml)` with the default serializer. Replace the body of `play()` and the bottom helpers with:

```kotlin
    fun play(webView: WebView, sigml: String) {
        val payload = Json.encodeToString(kotlinx.serialization.builtins.serializer<String>(), sigml)
        webView.evaluateJavascript("window.playSigML($payload);", null)
    }
```

## `android/app/src/main/assets/avatar/index.html`

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Oarumi — SiGML</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #17181b; color: #e6e7ea;
    font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  }
  #stage {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
    padding: 12px; align-content: flex-start;
    min-height: 60px;
  }
  .symbol {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    background: #2a2d33; border: 1px solid #3b3e45;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px;
    animation: pop 300ms ease-out;
  }
  .symbol.unknown { background: #402323; border-color: #6a2f2f; color: #ffbcbc; }
  #empty { padding: 12px; color: #6c6f76; font-size: 12px; }
  @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0.3; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="empty">No sign loaded.</div>
  <div id="stage"></div>
  <script>
    window.playSigML = function (xml) {
      const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
      const empty = document.getElementById('empty');
      stage.innerHTML = '';
      if (!xml) { empty.textContent = 'No sign loaded.'; return; }
      try {
        const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'text/xml');
        if (doc.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length > 0) {
          empty.textContent = 'SiGML parse error.'; return;
        }
        const manual = doc.getElementsByTagName('hamnosys_manual')[0];
        if (!manual) { empty.textContent = 'No hamnosys_manual element.'; return; }
        empty.textContent = '';
        for (const child of Array.from(manual.children)) {
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          if (child.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'hamunknown') {
            div.className = 'symbol unknown';
            div.textContent = '?' + (child.getAttribute('sym') || '');
          } else {
            div.className = 'symbol';
            div.textContent = child.tagName;
          }
          stage.appendChild(div);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        empty.textContent = 'Error: ' + e;
      }
    };
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```markdown
# CWASA bundle placeholder

Drop the CWASA client-side bundle (`allcsa.min.js`, `cwasa.css`, `av-*.js`)
into this directory and add the corresponding `<script>` tags to
`../index.html` to enable the real 3D avatar. The Python desktop app ships
with the same viewer in `desktop/resources/avatar/index.html`; the two must
stay in sync so cross-platform visual regression is meaningful.

Until the bundle is present, this WebView renders the HamNoSys symbol stream
as styled chips, which is deterministic and sufficient for parity tests.
```

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.di

import android.content.Context
import com.oarumi.app.data.audio.AndroidAudioSource
import com.oarumi.app.data.db.AndroidLanguageStore
import com.oarumi.app.data.db.AppDatabase
import com.oarumi.app.data.mlkit.MlKitTranslator
import com.oarumi.app.data.tts.AndroidTtsBackend
import com.oarumi.app.data.avatar.CwasaController
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import java.nio.file.Files
import javax.inject.Qualifier
import javax.inject.Singleton
import oarumi.config.EngineConfig
import oarumi.db.LanguageStore
import oarumi.nsm.NSMDecomposerTierA
import oarumi.nsm.NSMRealizer
import oarumi.nsm.NSMValidator
import oarumi.pipeline.Pipeline
import oarumi.pivot.PivotTranslator
import oarumi.reliability.AuditLog
import oarumi.reliability.IntentRouter
import oarumi.reliability.ReliabilityStack
import oarumi.reliability.StaticCapabilitySource
import oarumi.renderers.AudioAssetLibrary
import oarumi.renderers.AudioSource
import oarumi.renderers.SignRenderer
import oarumi.renderers.TactileRenderer
import oarumi.renderers.TtsBackend
import oarumi.renderers.TtsRenderer

@Qualifier @Retention(AnnotationRetention.BINARY)
annotation class OarumiHome

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object AppModule {

    @Provides @Singleton @OarumiHome
    fun provideHome(@ApplicationContext ctx: Context): java.nio.file.Path {
        val dir = java.nio.file.Path.of(ctx.filesDir.absolutePath, "oarumi")
        Files.createDirectories(dir)
        return dir
    }

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideEngineConfig(@OarumiHome home: java.nio.file.Path): EngineConfig =
        EngineConfig(
            home = home,
            strictParity = false,
            devModels = false,
            offline = true,
            logLevel = "INFO",
        )

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideAppDatabase(@ApplicationContext ctx: Context): AppDatabase =
        AppDatabase.create(ctx)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideLanguageStore(db: AppDatabase): LanguageStore =
        AndroidLanguageStore(db)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideAudioSource(@ApplicationContext ctx: Context): AudioSource =
        AndroidAudioSource(ctx.assets)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideAudioLibrary(source: AudioSource): AudioAssetLibrary =
        AudioAssetLibrary(source, requireVerified = false)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideTtsBackend(@ApplicationContext ctx: Context): TtsBackend =
        AndroidTtsBackend(ctx)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideMlKitTranslator(@ApplicationContext ctx: Context): MlKitTranslator =
        MlKitTranslator(ctx)

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideCwasaController(): CwasaController = CwasaController()

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideAuditLog(@OarumiHome home: java.nio.file.Path): AuditLog =
        AuditLog(home.resolve("audit.jsonl"))

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun provideReliabilityStack(audit: AuditLog, store: LanguageStore): ReliabilityStack {
        // The canary root is intentionally empty in the app; canaries are a dev-time
        // concept. Real failover recovery uses the shield + FSM without canary
        // gating until a canary set ships with the app.
        val emptyRoot = java.nio.file.Files.createTempDirectory("oarumi-canary-")
        return ReliabilityStack.create(
            auditPath = audit.path,
            canaryRoot = emptyRoot,
            capabilities = StaticCapabilitySource(
                db = store, offline = true,
            ),
        )
    }

    @Provides @Singleton
    fun providePipeline(
        store: LanguageStore,
        config: EngineConfig,
        audio: AudioAssetLibrary,
        ttsBackend: TtsBackend,
    ): Pipeline {
        val pipeline = Pipeline(
            db = store,
            config = config,
            pivot = PivotTranslator(config),
            decomposer = NSMDecomposerTierA(store),
            realizer = NSMRealizer(store),
            validator = NSMValidator(store),
        )
        val tts = TtsRenderer(audio = audio, backend = ttsBackend)
        val sign = SignRenderer(useExternal = false)
        val tactile = TactileRenderer()
        pipeline.registerRenderer("spoken") { s -> tts.render(s).toJsonObject() }
        pipeline.registerRenderer("signed") { s -> sign.render(s).toJsonObject() }
        pipeline.registerRenderer("tactile") { s -> tactile.render(s).toJsonObject() }
        return pipeline
    }
}
```

> The Pipeline in Kotlin does not yet have `registerRenderer` (Batch 7 shipped without it). Add the method to `Pipeline.kt` in § 0.8 below.

### 0.8 `engine/kotlin/src/main/kotlin/oarumi/pipeline/Pipeline.kt` — add renderer registry

Add this field and method:

```kotlin
    private val renderers: MutableMap<String, (OarumiSurface) -> kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject> =
        mutableMapOf()

    fun registerRenderer(
        modality: String,
        fn: (OarumiSurface) -> kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject,
    ) {
        renderers[modality] = fn
    }
```

Then, replace the `modalities = emptyMap()` in the success return with:

```kotlin
        val modalities = mutableMapOf<String, kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject>()
        val targets = buildList {
            add(req.modality)
            req.targetModality?.let { if (it != req.modality) add(it) }
        }
        for (m in targets) {
            val r = renderers[m] ?: continue
            try {
                modalities[m] = r(surface)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
```

```kotlin
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
class AndroidLanguageStoreTest {

    private lateinit var db: AppDatabase
    private lateinit var store: AndroidLanguageStore

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        // Use the packaged asset DB the same way the app does.
        db = Room.databaseBuilder(ctx, AppDatabase::class.java, "test-oarumi.db")
            .createFromAsset("oarumi.db")
```

### `android/app/src/test/java/com/oarumi/app/data/db/ParityWithJvmTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.db

import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import java.nio.file.Path
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import oarumi.db.LanguageDb
import oarumi.types.OarumiJson
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner

/**
 * Asserts that AndroidLanguageStore and LanguageDb return the same data
 * from the same SQLite file. This is the parity test Batch 13 refers to.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
class ParityWithJvmTest {

    private lateinit var jvm: LanguageDb
    private lateinit var db: AppDatabase
    private lateinit var android: AndroidLanguageStore

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        val jvmDbPath = Path.of("../language/oarumi.db")
        org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue(
            java.nio.file.Files.exists(jvmDbPath),
            "language/oarumi.db missing; run ./scripts/bootstrap.sh",
        )
        jvm = LanguageDb(jvmDbPath)

        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        db = Room.databaseBuilder(ctx, AppDatabase::class.java, "test-parity.db")
            .createFromAsset("oarumi.db")
            .build()
        android = AndroidLanguageStore(db)
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        db.close()
        jvm.close()
    }

    @Test
    fun `prime sets are identical`() {
        val jvmPrimes = jvm.allPrimes().associateBy { it.id }
        val androidPrimes = android.allPrimes().associateBy { it.id }
        assertEquals(jvmPrimes.keys, androidPrimes.keys)
        for (id in jvmPrimes.keys) {
            val a = jvmPrimes[id]!!
            val b = androidPrimes[id]!!
            assertEquals(a.gloss,       b.gloss,       "gloss for $id")
            assertEquals(a.category,    b.category,    "category for $id")
            assertEquals(a.combinators, b.combinators, "combinators for $id")
            assertEquals(a.spokenForm,  b.spokenForm,  "spoken_form for $id")
            assertEquals(a.signedForm,  b.signedForm,  "signed_form for $id")
            assertEquals(a.tactileForm, b.tactileForm, "tactile_form for $id")
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `lexeme search is identical`() {
        for (q in listOf("who", "manu", "hello", "x")) {
            val j = jvm.searchLexemes(q, limit = 50).map { it.phonForm }
            val a = android.searchLexemes(q, limit = 50).map { it.phonForm }
            assertEquals(j, a, "search '$q'")
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `get_by_phon is identical`() {
        for (phon in listOf("manu", "tinu", "ke", "si")) {
            val j = jvm.getLexemeByPhon(phon)
            val a = android.getLexemeByPhon(phon)
            assertEquals(j?.id, a?.id, "phon '$phon'")
            assertEquals(j?.gloss, a?.gloss, "gloss '$phon'")
        }
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private val json = OarumiJson
}
```

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.audio

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import oarumi.renderers.AudioAssetLibrary
import java.io.FileNotFoundException

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
class AndroidAudioSourceTest {

    private fun source(): AndroidAudioSource {
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        return AndroidAudioSource(ctx.assets)
    }

    @Test
    fun `manifest exists in assets`() {
        // The build stages language/oarumi.db, but audio assets are not staged
        // into the app. This test verifies the contract by checking the repo
        // fixture; the app test is skipped when assets are absent.
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        val repoManifest = java.nio.file.Path.of("../assets/audio/manifest.json")
        assumeTrue(java.nio.file.Files.exists(repoManifest),
            "run tools/generate_audio_assets.py first")
        // If assets are staged (Batch 12 adds the copy step), verify them.
        val staged = try { ctx.assets.open("audio/manifest.json").use { true } } catch (e: Exception) { false }
        if (!staged) return  // skip when not packaged
        val src = AndroidAudioSource(ctx.assets)
        assertTrue(src.exists("manifest.json"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `missing path raises`() {
        assertFailsWith<FileNotFoundException> {
            source().readText("definitely-not-there.json")
        }
    }
}
```

### `android/app/src/test/java/com/oarumi/app/data/tts/AndroidTtsBackendTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data.tts

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
class AndroidTtsBackendTest {

    @Test
    fun `initialises and reports availability`() = runTest {
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        val backend = AndroidTtsBackend(ctx)
        try {
            val ready = backend.awaitReady(timeoutMs = 500)
            // Robolectric may or may not provide a functional TTS engine; the
            // contract is that isAvailable() reflects actual state.
            assertTrue(ready == backend.isAvailable())
        } finally {
            backend.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `synthesize returns false when engine unavailable`() {
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        val backend = AndroidTtsBackend(ctx)
        try {
            if (backend.isAvailable()) return  // skip when engine is functional
            val out = java.nio.file.Files.createTempFile("tts-", ".wav")
            assertFalse(backend.synthesize("<speak>x</speak>", out))
        } finally {
            backend.close()
        }
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun touch(v: Any?) = assertNotNull(v)
}
```

### `android/app/src/androidTest/java/com/oarumi/app/data/EndToEndSmokeTest.kt`

```kotlin
package com.oarumi.app.data

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import java.nio.file.Files
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import oarumi.config.EngineConfig
import oarumi.db.LanguageStore
import oarumi.pipeline.Pipeline
import oarumi.renderers.AudioAssetLibrary
import oarumi.renderers.SignRenderer
import oarumi.renderers.TactileRenderer
import oarumi.renderers.TtsBackend
import oarumi.renderers.TtsRenderer
import oarumi.types.TranslationRequest
import com.oarumi.app.data.audio.AndroidAudioSource
import com.oarumi.app.data.db.AndroidLanguageStore
import com.oarumi.app.data.db.AppDatabase
import com.oarumi.app.data.tts.AndroidTtsBackend

/**
 * Instrumented smoke: opens the packaged DB via Room, runs a full translate,
 * and asserts that at least one modality payload is populated.
 *
 * Runs on the emulator in Batch 16's nightly job.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class EndToEndSmokeTest {

    @Test
    fun translate_hola_produces_spoken_and_signed() = runBlocking {
        val ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val db = AppDatabase.create(ctx)
        val store: LanguageStore = AndroidLanguageStore(db)

        val config = EngineConfig(
            home = java.nio.file.Path.of(ctx.filesDir.absolutePath),
            strictParity = false, devModels = false, offline = true, logLevel = "INFO",
        )
        val audio = AudioAssetLibrary(AndroidAudioSource(ctx.assets), requireVerified = false)
        val ttsBackend: TtsBackend = AndroidTtsBackend(ctx)
        try {
            val pipeline = Pipeline(db = store, config = config)
            val tts = TtsRenderer(audio = audio, backend = ttsBackend)
            val sign = SignRenderer(useExternal = false)
            val tactile = TactileRenderer()
            pipeline.registerRenderer("spoken")  { s -> tts.render(s).toJsonObject() }
            pipeline.registerRenderer("signed")  { s -> sign.render(s).toJsonObject() }
            pipeline.registerRenderer("tactile") { s -> tactile.render(s).toJsonObject() }

            val result = pipeline.translate(
                TranslationRequest(text = "hola", lang = "es", modality = "signed")
            )
            assertEquals(false, result.degraded)
            assertTrue(result.modalities.containsKey("signed"))
            val sigml = result.modalities["signed"]!!["sigml"]
            assertNotNull(sigml)
            val sigmlText = sigml.toString()
            assertTrue("hns_sign" in sigmlText)
        } finally {
            (ttsBackend as? AutoCloseable)?.close()
            db.close()
        }
    }

    @Suppress("unused")
    private fun touchFs() = Files.createTempFile("x", ".y")
}
```

## What this batch unlocks

- **Batch 11** (Android UI) can construct `Pipeline` via Hilt, call `pipeline.translate(req)`, and render `result.modalities` — the data layer contract is fully implemented.
- **Batch 12** (bootstrap wizard) uses `MlKitTranslator.ensureModel(lang)` per language selected; it also stages `audio/` assets into the APK (currently only `avatar/` is staged).
- **Batch 13** (parity harness) can now assert `ParityWithJvmTest` is green as a hard prerequisite for merging any engine change: Room and JDBC must return identical `Prime` and `Lexeme` lists.
- **Batch 14** (parity web GUI) uses the ML Kit pivot result as the `android` target when comparing against `python`; the `_canonical` normalization already handles the differing `backend` label.
- **Batch 16** (CI) adds `:app:testDebugUnitTest` (Robolectric) to the fast PR job and `:app:connectedDebugAndroidTest` to the nightly emulator job.

```kotlin
import com.oarumi.app.ui.theme.BadgeWarnBg
import com.oarumi.app.ui.theme.BadgeWarnFg

@Composable
fun OfflineBadge(offline: Boolean) {
    val (bg, fg) = if (offline) BadgeInfoBg to BadgeInfoFg else BadgeOkBg to BadgeOkFg
    val label = stringResource(if (offline) R.string.badge_offline else R.string.badge_online)
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
            .background(bg)
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = label,
            color = fg,
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun DegradedBadge(visible: Boolean) {
    if (!visible) return
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
            .background(BadgeWarnBg)
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = stringResource(R.string.badge_degraded),
            color = BadgeWarnFg,
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
        )
    }
}
```
